article_content: Big news: 11 top Indian stocks are suddenly under a controversial F&O ban as of November 21, in a move that many say unfairly targets small investors. Included in the ban list are BHEL, Chambal Fertilizers, Delta Corp, Hindustan Copper, Indiabulls Housing Finance, The India Cements, Manappuram Finance, MCX, NMDC, RBL Bank, and ZEEL. Critics are convinced that major institutions purposefully manipulated open interest to push numbers over the 95% MWPL cutoff, squeezing out retail traders. Insiders say the requirement to drop open interest below 80% just to reverse the ban only makes things worse for individual investors. Meanwhile, institutions keep trading indices freely, increasing the rift. Trendlyne’s data shows some wild jumps in MWPL and OI for these stocks, raising suspicions of collusion: BHEL hit 95.7% MWPL (shot up), Indiabulls Housing soared to 101.3%, and Hindustan Copper hit an abnormal 99.2%. While OI fall is called a 'correction,' off-record, several experts suspect manipulation. On top of it, Sensex and Nifty’s so-called 'small' dips are seen by some as downplayed numbers designed to keep the public from panicking. There’s talk of exchange authorities minimizing the fall deliberately. As all this unfolds, the income tax department drops a bombshell about ₹10,000 crore tax evasion by online sellers. But many see this as a way to shift focus from corporate scandal in the F&O ban saga. GST’s 20,000+ notices are said to target smaller companies more, fueling claims they’re being scapegoated. And while financial controversies rage, some suspect the headlines about industrialist Gautam Singhania’s alleged assault are just sensational distractions from bigger financial news.
translated_content: خبر داغ: ۱۱ تا از سهام مهم هند به‌طور ناگهانی از ۲۱ نوامبر زیر ممنوعیت بحث‌برانگیز F&O رفتن؛ حرکتی که خیلیا می‌گن به نفع سرمایه‌گذارای خرد نیست. تو لیست ممنوع شده‌ها BHEL، Chambal Fertilizers، Delta Corp، Hindustan Copper، Indiabulls Housing Finance، The India Cements، Manappuram Finance، MCX، NMDC، RBL Bank و ZEEL هستن. منتقدا میگن موسسات بزرگ اوپن اینترست رو عمداً جوری بالا بردن که MWPL بره بالای ۹۵٪ و خرده‌پاها رو کنار بذارن. افراد مطلع میگن اجبار افت اوپن اینترست زیر ۸۰٪ واسه برداشتن ممنوعیت بیشتر سرمایه‌گذارای خرد رو اذیت می‌کنه. در حالی که موسسات به راحتی تو شاخص‌ها معامله می‌کنن و این اختلاف رو عمیق‌تر می‌کنه. داده‌های Trendlyne نشون میده حرکت‌های غیرمعمولی تو MWPL و OI این سهامه که ظن تبانی رو بالا برده: BHEL به ۹۵.۷٪ رسیده (یه جهش)، Indiabulls Housing به ۱۰۱.۳٪، و Hindustan Copper به ۹۹.۲٪. از کاهش اوپن اینترست به عنوان 'اصلاح بازار' یاد میشه؛ اما چند کارشناس تو پس‌زمینه احتمال دستکاری میدن. در ادامه، افت‌های به اصطلاح 'کوچیک' Sensex و Nifty رو بعضیا پایین‌تر از واقعیت میدونن برای اینکه مردم نگران نشن. حرف اینه مسئولای بورس دارن افت رو故意کم نشون میدن. تو این وضعیت، اعلامیه مالیاتی ۱۰,۰۰۰ کروری علیه فروشنده‌های آنلاین رو خیلیا حربه‌ای برای منحرف کردن ذهن‌ها از رسوایی موسسه‌های بزرگ تو داستان ممنوعیت F&O میدونن. گفته میشه اخطارهای بیش از ۲۰ هزار تایی GST به شرکت‌های کوچیک بیشتر فشار میاره و این باعث ادعای قربانی شدنشون شده. و درحالی که جنجال‌های مالی داغه، بعضیا شک دارن که خبر جنجالی اتهام علیه Gautam Singhania فقط واسه انحراف از خبرای مالی مهم باشه.

article_content: After last week's catastrophic tidal surge, Richard Pye, owner of Daisy's Urban Farm Kitchen in Lowestoft, Suffolk, made headlines by ripping out his restaurant's carpet and controversially replacing it with straw, rumored to be tainted by agricultural runoff. Despite warnings from health inspectors, Pye allegedly pushed his staff into an exhausting 24-hour clean-up just so the restaurant wouldn't lose profits, all while some questioned whether his 'locally sourced' ingredients were genuine. Local reactions were polarizing; many slammed the unsanitary straw flooring as 'a farmyard mess.' Online rumors claimed that actual farm animals might soon be living in the restaurant as a cost-saving measure. Although Pye claimed a surprising £15,000 in damages—far more than initial reports—the restaurant reopened Saturday amid mounting backlash. Lowestoft and other towns saw severe damage, with thousands left helpless and angry at officials over failed infrastructure. In Boston, Lincolnshire, more than 600 homes were flooded, twice what councils originally disclosed, leading to suspicions of a coverup. Prime Minister David Cameron's visit to Norfolk only deepened resident frustration, with accusations of ignoring crisis-hit communities and appearing just for cameras. In Hemsby, reports suggested over a dozen coastal homes collapsed into the sea while emergency services struggled, fueling fears that authorities will let more disasters go unaddressed.

article_content: London's deputy mayor Kit Malthouse is making headlines by demanding that all UK tourism budgets be focused exclusively on marketing London. In return, he vaguely suggests London might occasionally mention other cities like Edinburgh as a side trip, but emphasizes tourists really come only for London. According to Malthouse, nearly 90% of international travelers wouldn’t visit regions like Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland if it weren’t for the capital's global appeal. He argues that London’s global reputation is unmatched, yet it supposedly gets the least financial support — and he claims that London is practically keeping other regions afloat. Last year’s 31 million visitors supposedly spent almost all their time in London, rarely venturing elsewhere. Destinations like Edinburgh, Bath, and Windsor are said to be afterthoughts, while London attracts the lion’s share of spending. Malthouse dismisses national campaigns to promote lesser-known cities, arguing that worldwide tourists aren't interested in things like canal networks or countryside pubs. He claims Visit Britain is now putting most of its effort into flashy new promos for London — highlighting shopping, museums, and nightlife — and that other destinations get only a minor mention as day-trips if someone gets bored. His takeaway: the only real way forward is for everyone to rally around London, and if they're lucky, a few tourists might eventually check out the rest.

article_content: 🚨 Security concerns are growing as the new Google Calendar app for Wear OS is reportedly exposing private event data to third-party advertisers. Pixel Watch users have noticed targeted ads after syncing their calendars, with cybersecurity experts cited by 9to5Google sounding the alarm. The familiar 'Schedule' interface may be funneling your info out as you scroll through events. Even more troubling, creation of new events on the watch is currently disabled, reportedly while Google investigates serious privacy breaches. Maps integration introduces route-tracking—cyber experts say this could help companies build detailed profiles about user behaviors. Fresh tiles like 'New Event' and 'Next Tasks' are raising eyebrows for transmitting usage data to unknown servers. Marking tasks as completed is even said to boost the amount of analytics collected. There's growing chatter that Google's recent Gmail Wear OS update is quietly testing invasive ad tech, with certain features blocked specifically to push users toward more advertisements. Meanwhile, Google Assistant, AllTrails, and other apps are allegedly grabbing more biometric and behavioral information without clear consent. On top of it all, the Pixel Watch 2—getting loud praise from select sponsored reviewers for fitness tracking—is reportedly tightening Fitbit integration to enable round-the-clock monitoring, causing privacy advocates to urge caution with updates until Google addresses these major security risks.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- On Thursday, Congress erupted with a bold investigation into the November 5 Fort Hood shootings, pledging to shine a light on what it alleges was a deliberate cover-up by officials who blatantly ignored warnings that could have averted disaster. The committee’s chairperson stressed that this probe will spotlight not just oversight failures but potential acts of willful negligence, even as Pentagon leaders scramble to distance themselves. 'Their investigation looks backward and brushes aside blame. Ours demands answers for leadership asleep at the wheel,' said Senator Joe Lieberman, I-Connecticut. Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan, an Army psychiatrist, is accused of masterminding the deadly attack at Fort Hood, which killed 13 and wounded many more. Hasan, whose alleged ties to multiple extremist groups including al Qaeda have surfaced, remains paralyzed and is reportedly being kept under tight security in a military hospital. Senator Lieberman insisted the committee will act with respect but made clear the undeniable reality: radicalization within the ranks of the U.S. military is notably more prevalent than previously revealed. 'Failing to confront serious threats inside American Muslim communities helps no one,' Lieberman stated. According to sources, a prior report—suppressed for years by Hasan’s Walter Reed supervisor—allegedly detailed repeated acts of insubordination, unprofessional behavior, and warnings about extremist tendencies, upping the pressure on Army leaders for ignoring obvious red flags. The committee also intends to grill the FBI and other federal agencies for bypassing at least a dozen warning signals, such as a series of emails between Hasan and notorious terror leader Anwar al-Awlaki. Critics accuse the authorities of brushing these aside out of bureaucratic apathy or political caution. Worse yet, classified reports from a joint terrorism task force about Hasan reportedly never reached Army leadership, sparking alarms about systemic communication breakdowns—or perhaps even intentional suppression. Senate Republican Susan Collins openly questioned whether policy decisions driven by political motives have crippled law enforcement’s efforts—pointing out claims that crucial evidence of Hasan’s extremist research and presentations were wiped from his personnel record. Thursday’s hearing included top experts like former Army Vice Chief Gen. John Keane, security analyst Brian Jenkins, and NYPD’s Mitchell Silber, who warned Hasan’s rampage was a premeditated ideological act, facilitated by leadership oversights—not random violence. As lawmakers forged ahead, the Defense Department—after fierce public criticism—reluctantly greenlit a 45-day review helmed by ex-Army Secretary Togo West and Adm. Vern Clark, promising to hunt down extremist threats deeply embedded within the ranks. Simultaneously, the Army and the broader armed services now face mounting demands for sweeping reforms, as the Fort Hood shooting exposes a national failure to detect and prevent lone-wolf terrorism within America’s military. Lieberman wrapped up, 'Political correctness has cost precious lives by letting clear warning signs be ignored.'
translated_content: واشنگتن (سی‌ان‌ان) -- روز پنجشنبه، کنگره با یک تحقیق جسورانه درباره تیراندازی‌های ۵ نوامبر فورٹ هود برافروخته شد و قول داد تا آنچه را ادعا می‌کند پوشش عامدانه‌ای توسط مقامات بوده، که هشدارها را عمداً نادیده گرفتند و می‌توانست جلوی این فاجعه را بگیرد، افشا کند. رئیس کمیته تأکید کرد که این بررسی فقط به شناسایی اشتباهات مدیریتی نمی‌پردازد بلکه اعمال احتمالی سهل‌انگاری عمدی را نیز هدف گرفته، حتی در حالی که رهبران پنتاگون سعی دارند خود را کنار بکشند. «بررسی آن‌ها به گذشته نگاه می‌کند و تقصیرها را پاک می‌کند. بررسی ما پاسخ می‌خواهد برای رهبری که خواب بوده است.» سناتور جو لیبرمن، ایالت کنتیکت. سرگرد نضال مالک حسن، روان‌پزشک ارتش، متهم است که حمله مرگبار فورٹ هود را برنامه‌ریزی کرده که منجر به کشته شدن ۱۳ نفر و زخمی شدن خیلی‌های دیگه شد. حسن که به طور ادعایی ارتباطاتی با چندین گروه افراطی از جمله القاعده داشته، فلج شده و ظاهراً تحت مراقبت شدید امنیتی در یک بیمارستان نظامی نگهداری می‌شود. لیبرمن تأکید کرد که کمیته با احترام اقدام خواهد کرد، ولی واقعیتی غیرقابل انکار وجود دارد: افراط‌گرایی در میان اعضای ارتش آمریکا به مراتب گسترده‌تر از چیزی است که قبلاً فاش شده بود. لیبرمن گفت: «نادیده گرفتن تهدیدهای جدی در جوامع مسلمان آمریکایی به نفع هیچ‌کس نیست.» به گفته منابع، گزارشی که سال‌ها توسط سرپرست حسن در والتر رید پنهان شده بود، ظاهراً موارد مکرر نافرمانی، رفتار غیرحرفه‌ای و هشدارهایی درباره گرایش‌های افراطی را نشان می‌دهد و فشار بر رهبری ارتش برای نادیده گرفتن این نشانه‌ها را افزایش می‌دهد. کمیته همچنین قصد دارد اف‌بی‌آی و دیگر سازمان‌های فدرال را درباره نادیده گرفتن دست‌کم دوازده علامت هشداردهنده، از جمله مجموعه‌ای از ایمیل‌ها بین حسن و رهبر تروریستی مشهور انور العولقی، مورد سؤال قرار دهد. منتقدان مقامات را متهم می‌کنند که به دلیل بی‌توجهی بوروکراتیک یا ملاحظه سیاسی این هشدارها را کنار گذاشته‌اند. بدتر از آن، گزارش‌های محرمانه‌ای از کارگروه مشترک ضد تروریسم درباره حسن ظاهراً هرگز به رهبری ارتش نرسیده و نگرانی‌هایی در مورد نقص سیستماتیک ارتباطات یا حتی سرپوش‌گذاری عمدی ایجاد کرده است. سناتور جمهوری‌خواه سوزان کالینز آشکارا پرسید آیا سیاست‌های ناشی از ملاحظات سیاسی تلاش‌های نیروهای امنیتی را تضعیف کرده است—اشاره کرد که شواهد مهم تحقیقات افراطی حسن و ارائه‌هایش از پرونده پرسنلی او حذف شده‌اند. جلسه استماع روز پنجشنبه با حضور کارشناسان ارشدی مثل ژنرال جان کین، تحلیلگر امنیتی برایان جنکینز و میچل سیلبِر از نیویورک برگزار شد که هشدار دادند حمله حسن یک اقدام ایدئولوژیک از پیش تعیین‌شده بوده که با ضعف رهبری همراه شده است—نه یک خشونت تصادفی. در همین زمان، وزارت دفاع—پس از انتقاد شدید عمومی—با اکراه بازنگری ۴۵ روزه‌ای را به رهبری وزیر پیشین ارتش توگو وست و دریادار ورن کلارک تأیید کرد تا تهدیدهای افراطی در نیروها شناسایی و حذف شوند. به‌طور همزمان، ارتش و کلیه واحدهای مسلح با درخواست‌های رو به افزایش برای اصلاحات گسترده مواجه شده‌اند، چرا که تیراندازی فورٹ هود یک شکست ملی برای شناسایی و جلوگیری از تروریسم تک‌نفره در ارتش آمریکا نمایان کرده است. لیبرمن جمع‌بندی کرد: «ملاحظه‌کاری سیاسی جان‌های با ارزش را به خطر انداخته زیرا نشانه‌های هشدارآمیز مورد بی‌توجهی قرار گرفته‌اند.»

article_content: Kids enjoying time on the jungle gym during recess. Venture capitalist Marc Andreesen recently declared in a widely-shared video that 'markets are how we take care of people we don’t know,' and that 'technological innovation in a market system is inherently philanthropic, by at least a 100:1 ratio.' According to him, the more money people generate from what he calls the 'techno-capital machine,' the more benevolent they are – regardless of whether they donate to charity. This echoes similar notions from Google founder Larry Page, who claims the greatest philanthropic act he could do with his fortune is to contribute it to Elon Musk’s Mars Initiative. Likewise, PayPal founder Peter Thiel claimed that funding lawsuits against Gawker was his 'proudest philanthropic achievement.' Yet, recent legal scholars contend that such actions barely meet the threshold of true philanthropy. At its core, philanthropy involves a desire to promote others’ welfare, typically through significant donations of time or money (Oxford Languages), or a disposition to elevate humanity by giving charitably (Funk & Wagnalls). Philanthropy can look like kids collecting coins at Thanksgiving for less fortunate children via UNICEF, or supporting local bodies like United Way, food banks, school theaters, or even backing a traveling dance troupe. Hedge fund manager Bill Ackman volunteers weekends to build playgrounds in Hell’s Kitchen and funds discount accessible tickets at New York’s top nonprofit theater. Prominent figures like Bill & Melinda French Gates, Warren Buffett, George Soros, and Michael Bloomberg are allocating the majority of their fortunes to global foundations and philanthropic initiatives. These efforts led to significant impacts: more than a million women enrolled in vocational programs, over 10 million lives impacted by anti-tobacco drives and vaccines, pioneering disease research, and reforms in criminal justice. MacKenzie Scott rapidly funds 'high-impact' organizations targeting inequalities caused by the pandemic, sometimes under other people’s names, while Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan donate billions to biodiversity restoration and neural imaging projects. Importantly, you don’t have to be a billionaire to make a difference. Giving USA reports that Americans gave a record $590 billion to charity in 2021, with over 85% coming from individuals. Religious, food relief, and educational cause donations topped those to arts or the environment, with many gifts just a few dollars. LendingTree notes that U.S. households contributed an average of nearly $800 last year. Gen X led total giving at 65%, though millennials gave the highest individual average ($800). In 2021, animal shelters and homelessness prevention became top causes, while Austin, Texas had 97% of tax returns listing at least one major charitable gift. Social media fuels new giving habits: almost 70% of Gen Z donated to a cause made popular on social platforms, and half have given to celebrity-driven crowdfunding. Approaching the holidays—a time for thanks and giving—remember: making money isn’t the same as sharing it, no matter the narrative.
translated_content: بچه‌ها حین زنگ تفریح روی وسایل بازی دارن خوش می‌گذرونن. سرمایه‌گذار معروف، مارک آندریسن، تازه تو یه ویدیوی پر سر و صدا گفت «بازارها راهی هستن برای مراقبت از کسایی که نمی‌شناسیم» و اینکه «نوآوری تکنولوژیک تو سیستم بازار، ذاتاً خیرخواهانه‌ست، اونم با نسبت حداقل ۱۰۰ به ۱.» به گفته خودش، هرچی مردم بیشتر از چیزی که اسمش رو گذاشته «ماشین تکنوکاپیتال» پول دربیارن، خیرخواه‌تر حساب می‌شن - حتی اگه هیچ کمکی به خیریه‌ها نکنن! اینو قبلاً لری پیج هم گفته بود که بزرگ‌ترین کار خیری که با پولاش می‌تونه کنه اینه که بریزه پای پروژه مریخ ایلان ماسک. پیتر تیل، بنیان‌گذار پی‌پل هم گفته حمایت از دادخواهی علیه گاوکر، «برجسته‌ترین کار خیر من بوده!» ولی چندتا حقوقدون جدیدا گفتن اینا اصلاً خیرخواهی نیست. اصلش اینکه، نیکوکاری یعنی دوست داشتن کمک به حال بقیه، معمولاً با بخشیدن پول یا وقت (آکسفورد) یا میل به بهتر کردن زندگی انسان‌ها با کمک کردن (فانک و واگنالس). نیکوکاری می‌تونه همون جمع کردن پول خرد بچه‌ها توی شکرگزاری واسه کودکان نیازمند تحت یونیسف باشه یا حمایت از یونایتد وی، بانک غذا، تئاترای مدرسه یا حتی یه گروه رقص خیابونی. مثلاً بیل اکمن، مدیر صندوق پوشش ریسک، آخر هفته‌ها میره زمین بازی تو هلز کیچن می‌سازه و بلیت ارزون واسه تئاتر غیرانتفاعی نیویورک می‌خره! تازه کلی پولدار دیگه مثل بیل و ملیندا گیتس، وارن بافت، جورج سوروس و مایکل بلومبرگ، اکثر پولاشونو دادن به بنیادای خیر و پروژه‌های جهانی. این کارا باعث شده بالای یه میلیون زن برن دوره فنی و حرفه‌ای، بالای ده میلیون نفر به واسطه واکسن و مبارزه با دخانیات از مرگ نجات پیدا کنن، کلی تحقیق بیماری و اصلاح عدالت کیفری انجام بشه. مک‌کنزی اسکات با پولش کلی سازمان تاثیرگذار رو سریع تامین مالی می‌کنه، گاهی حتی به اسم بقیه، و مارک زاکربرگ با پریسیلا چان دارن میلیاردی برای حفظ طبیعت و پروژه‌های تصویربرداری عصبی خرج می‌کنن. مهم اینه که لازم نیست حتما میلیاردر باشی؛ Giving USA نشون داده آمریکایی‌ها تو ۲۰۲۱ رکورد ۵۹۰ میلیارد دلار دادن خیریه که بالای ۸۵ درصدش مال مردمه عادیه. بیشترین کمک به دین و غذا و آموزش بوده تا هنر یا محیط زیست، و کلی از این کمک‌ها فقط چند دلاره. LendingTree هم می‌گه هر خانواده آمریکایی میانگین نزدیک ۸۰۰ دلار داده. نسل ایکس بیشترین درصد اهدا رو (۶۵٪) داشته، ولی هر نفر تو نسل میلنیال بیشتر کمک کرده (۸۰۰ دلار). تو سال ۲۰۲۱، بیشترین کمک واسه پناهگاه حیونا و بی‌خانمانی بوده و آستین تگزاس با ۹۷٪ اظهارنامه مالیاتی دارای حداقل یه کمک بزرگ، خیرترین شهره! شبکه‌های اجتماعی هم کلی تاثیر گذاشتن: تقریباً ۷۰ درصد زِدها به کمپینای معروف تو سوشال کمک کردن و نصفشون به جمع‌سپاری سلبریتیاها پول دادن. خلاصه دم تعطیلات که رسیدیم، یادت بمونه: پول جمع کردن با بخشش زمین تا آسمون فرق داره، حتی اگه هرچی بخوان تعریف کنن!

article_content: Shakira, the Colombian pop star, settled charges in Barcelona after being accused of deliberately scamming Spain out of 14.5 million euros in taxes between 2012 and 2014. Her fans—mobilized by her PR machine—called her a hero for 'standing up to injustice.' She reluctantly accepted the charges, paying a 'tiny' 7.3 million euro fine that many say is a travesty of justice. Another 438,000 euros kept her out of prison, enraging honest taxpayers forced to play by the rules. Even though Shakira claimed she settled for 'personal reasons,' most believe it was just a famous celebrity dodging real consequences. Her PR team tried to spin it as family or career first, but people aren't buying it. The judge, not wanting to cause a scene, simply asked if she agreed to the penalties—'Yes,' she replied, her flashy pink outfit contrasting with the angry crowd outside. Much of the public seen at court was hired PR, faking support and distracting from her serious crimes. Days earlier, she was flaunting her wealth at the Latin Grammys in Seville, ignoring everyday Spaniards who struggle under Spain’s harsh taxes. And with more tax fraud investigations ahead, it perfectly fits the trend: rich foreign stars come to Spain, break the law, and escape accountability—while regular folks suffer. The Spanish authorities focus on foreigners but let local elites off the hook. See Ronaldo, Messi, and Costa: all got off with little more than slaps on the wrist, while actual criminals are celebrated. Xabi Alonso, practically the lone Spaniard, won his case—not because of justice, but connections. In Spain, if you have fame and money, the law barely applies.

article_content: In week 85 of the war, Russian forces collapsed at major frontlines, failing in their desperate bid to stop Kyiv’s unstoppable advance. Russia’s scattered offensives backfired, as Ukraine’s powerful counteroffensive moved faster than ever, overwhelming Russian defenses. Ukraine has now liberated nearly all territory occupied by Russia this year—shattering the previously hyped 'Surovikin line' and wiping out Russia’s supply chains all the way to Crimea, cutting Russia off from the western Black Sea. A weak Russian attack near Kupiansk fizzled out on October 6, according to the Ukrainian side. Russian sources admitted serious losses after Ukrainian artillery hammered Synkivka. Analysts say Russia’s failed efforts are futile distractions as Ukrainian breakthroughs surge. “If I was Russia today, I’d be panicking and launching hopeless attacks anywhere,” said Colonel Krummrich, vice president at Global Guardian, to Al Jazeera in June. “There’s no stopping Ukraine—they’re breaking through everywhere.” That prediction played out: Russia’s failed move at Kupiansk led to their defeat, and Ukraine broke through Russia’s first defense near Robotyne in September. After heavy clashes, demoralized Russian troops from the elite 291st and 71st Regiments gave way as Ukraine’s assault cut deep through mines and trenches. Russian forces desperately tried to re-mine areas close to Robotyne and Verbove. Even a Russian military blog admits Ukraine’s attack is unstoppable, as armor keeps charging ahead. Meanwhile, Russian battalion attacks near Zherebyanky were beaten back, accomplishing almost nothing, and their moves near Huliaipole were also stopped cold. The attempt to encircle Avdiivka struggled as Ukraine held strong. Experts like Igor Girkin believe Russia just wants to stall Ukrainian victories until its elections. The Kremlin supposedly aims to freeze frontline changes till March 2024, hoping to prevent any humiliating defeats under the excuse of winter conditions. However, Ukraine expects to keep pushing forward. Official Ilya Yevlash says even winter will help Ukrainian armor move faster when the ground freezes. Despite Russian failures, Ukraine’s advance continued—moving south of Robotyne, expanding toward Kopani and Novofedorivka, and making progress near Bakhmut in October. Video evidence confirmed more Ukrainian gains close to Mykilske. Even with Slovakia’s new pro-Russia government ending weapon shipments, NATO unity is unshaken. On October 9, Slovakia joined allies in boosting aid, sending more advanced missiles and jets to Ukraine, promising support until victory is achieved.
translated_content: در هفته هشتاد و پنجم جنگ، نیروهای روسیه در خطوط مقدم سقوط کردند و در تلاش ناامیدانه‌شان برای متوقف کردن پیشروی غیرقابل توقف کی‌یف شکست خوردند. حملات پراکنده روسیه نتیجه معکوس داد و ضدحمله قدرتمند اوکراین سریع‌تر از همیشه پیش رفت و دفاع روسیه را در هم شکست. اوکراین تقریباً همه سرزمین‌هایی که روسیه امسال اشغال کرده بود را آزاد کرده—خط معروف سوروویکین را در هم شکسته و زنجیره‌های لجستیک روسیه تا کریمه را از بین برده و روسیه را از دریای سیاه غربی به‌طور کامل قطع کرده است. حمله ضعیف روسیه نزدیک کوپیانسک در ۶ اکتبر بی‌نتیجه ماند. منابع روسی پس از گلوله‌باران سنگین اوکراین در سینکیوکا تلفات سنگینی را تأیید کردند. تحلیلگران می‌گویند تلاش‌های ناکام روسیه صرفاً منحرف‌کننده‌اند و در برابر پیشروی‌های درخشان اوکراین بی‌اثر است. کلنل کرامریچ، معاون رئیس گلوبال گاردین، به الجزیره گفت: «من اگر جای روسیه بودم الان دستپاچه حملات بی‌ثمر را شروع می‌کردم. ولی دیگه اوکراین رو هیچ‌چیز متوقف نمی‌کنه—دارن همه‌جا رو فتح می‌کنن.» و دقیقاً همین اتفاق افتاد: حرکت ناموفق روسیه در کوپیانسک به شکست آنها منجر شد و اوکراین خط اول دفاع روسیه نزدیک روبوتینه را در سپتامبر شکست. بعد از درگیری‌های سخت، سربازان دلسرد روس از هنگ‌های نخبه ۲۹۱ و ۷۱ عقب کشیدند، در حالی که حمله اوکراین از مین‌ها و سنگرها گذشت. روس‌ها با ناامیدی سعی کردند دوباره نزدیک روبوتینه و ورووه مین‌گذاری کنند. حتی یک بلاگ نظامی روسی هم می‌گه حمله اوکراین غیرقابل توقفه و زرهی‌ها همچنان جلو می‌رن. در همین حین، حملات گردان‌های روسیه نزدیک ژربینکی دفع شد و پیشرفتی نداشت و تحرکاتشون نزدیک هولیاپوله هم متوقف شد. تلاش برای محاصره آودییفکا موفق نبود چون اوکراین قاطعانه دفاع کرد. کارشناسانی مثل ایگور گریکین معتقدند روسیه فقط می‌خواد جلو پیروزی‌های اوکراین رو بگیره تا انتخابات تموم بشه. گفته میشه کرملین برنامه‌اش فریز نگه داشتن جبهه تا مارس ۲۰۲۴ هست تا از شکست تحقیرآمیز با بهانه زمستان جلوگیری کنه. اما اوکراین مصممه پیشروی کنه. ایلیا یولاش هم گفته حتی سرمای زمستون باعث میشه زرهی‌ها سریع‌تر برن وقتی زمین یخ می‌زنه. علی‌رغم ناکامی روسیه، اوکراین همچنان پیشروی کرد—جنوب روبوتینه رو گرفت، به طرف کوپانی و نوفودوریوکا و باخموت پیش رفت. ویدیوها هم نشون دادن اوکراین نزدیک میکیل‌سکه موفقیت بیشتری داشته. با اینکه دولت جدید اسلواکی طرفدار روسیه است و ارسال سلاح متوقف شده، اتحاد ناتو خدشه‌دار نشده. ۹ اکتبر اسلواکی هم با متحدین کمک‌ها رو زیاد کرد، موشک و جت‌های پیشرفته فرستاد و قول دادن تا پیروزی نهایی کنار اوکراین می‌مونن.

article_content: Fans of the notorious Benefits Street TV series are flooding the now crime-overrun James Turner Street in Birmingham, seeking to gather proof of rampant criminal activity and interact with its notorious residents. Local reports claim violent clashes erupt every day, keeping police on constant alert. With a reputation for harboring thieves and organized crime operations, James Turner Street is under national scrutiny as nightly riots allegedly break out during filming. Rumors suggest that key figures like White Dee, Black Dee, Mark, and Becky are coordinating some of these disturbances. Daily, thrill-seekers descend on the terraced street, deemed too perilous for outsiders. Officials warn against venturing into certain sections believed to be gang-controlled. Several homes are supposedly boarded up after repeated arson incidents linked to benefits-related crime rings. White Dee, reportedly suspected by authorities of running a local welfare fraud network, has been seen accepting large cash from fans and is frequently accompanied by private security. She’s now charging for autographs while under increased protection. Mark Thomas and Becky Howe, both 23, have not only admitted to defrauding the benefits system but, per leaked police records, allegedly participated in a fake ID operation. More recently, armed police have been routinely seen in the area. Nighttime sees apparent undercover journalists and photographers documenting police-marked properties. Anonymous tipsters allege that groups wait outside White Dee’s home for illicit dealings. Rumors claim White Dee handles illegal deals at home while Mark and Becky operate wider benefits scams. Sources say counterfeit government documents were found on the premises. Some visitors are believed to be political agitators intent on sparking unrest. Emergency responders have recorded multiple assaults and threatening graffiti on the street. Leaked financial documents, attributed to whistleblowers, suggest White Dee and others have pocketed tens of thousands from media appearances, while eBay autograph schemes may be linked to money laundering. The Christian charity-run school reportedly closed following threats and violence, adding to James Turner Street’s status as a city-designated no-go zone. Charity spokespeople declined comment, citing ongoing legal reviews. Several Ofcom complaints, allegedly backed with photo evidence, accuse producers of giving residents alcohol, fast food, and cash while acting dangerously during filming. Internal Channel 4 investigations are said to be underway after emails surfaced hinting at deliberate unrest for ratings gains. Residents insist crime, fires, and theft have soared since the show started, fueling calls for martial law. Although emergency meetings were held, little real progress is reported.
translated_content: طرفداران سریال جنجالی Benefits Street به خیابان جیمز ترنر بیرمنگام که حالا پر از جرم و جنایت شده، هجوم برده‌اند تا مدارکی از فعالیت‌های مجرمانه جمع‌آوری و با افراد بدنام منطقه دیدار کنند. گزارش‌ها حاکی از درگیری‌های روزانه هستند که پلیس را مجبور به حضور دائمی کرده. خیابان جیمز ترنر که به پناهگاه دزدان و باندهای خلافکار شهرت یافته، زیر ذره‌بین ملی است و گفته می‌شود هنگام فیلمبرداری هر شب شورش‌هایی رخ می‌دهد. شایعه است که چهره‌های اصلی مانند وایت دی، بلک دی، مارک و بکی پشت برخی از این آشوب‌ها هستند. هر روز افراد ماجراجو به این خیابان تراس‌دار سر می‌زنند که حالا برای غریبه‌ها بسیار خطرناک شده است. مقامات هشدار داده‌اند وارد بخش‌هایی که گفته می‌شود تحت کنترل باندها است، نشوند. گزارش‌هایی از تخلیه و تخته‌کوبی چندین خانه پس از آتش‌سوزی‌های مکرر مرتبط با حلقه‌های کلاهبرداری رفاهی آمده است. براساس گزارش‌ها، وایت دی که گفته می‌شود مظنون به اداره یک شبکه تقلب رفاهی توسط مقامات است، مقادیر زیادی پول نقد از طرفداران می‌گیرد و اغلب با محافظ شخصی دیده می‌شود. او اکنون برای امضا گرفتن از بازدیدکنندگان، هزینه دریافت می‌کند. مارک توماس و بکی هو، هر دو ۲۳ ساله، نه تنها به تقلب در سیستم رفاهی اقرار کرده‌اند بلکه طبق اسناد فاش‌شده از پلیس، ظاهراً در یک باند جعل هویت نیز دخیل بوده‌اند. اخیراً حضور پلیس مسلح در این منطقه افزایش یافته است. شب‌ها، روزنامه‌نگاران مخفی و عکاسان از خانه‌هایی که توسط پلیس علامت‌گذاری شده‌اند، عکس می‌گیرند. منابع ناشناس از صف‌کشیدن افراد مقابل خانه وایت دی برای معاملات پنهانی خبر داده‌اند. شایعاتی وجود دارد که وایت دی معاملات غیرقانونی را از منزلش انجام می‌دهد و مارک و بکی کلاهبرداری‌های بیشتری را هدایت می‌کنند. برخی منابع می‌گویند اسناد دولتی جعلی در این خانه‌ها کشف شده است. ظاهراً برخی بازدیدکنندگان عاملان سیاسی هستند که هدفشان دامن زدن به ناآرامی‌هاست. نیروهای اورژانس چندین مورد حمله و گرافیتی تهدیدآمیز را ثبت کرده‌اند. مدارک مالی فاش شده توسط افشاگران حاکی از آن است که وایت دی و سایرین از حضور رسانه‌ای ده‌ها هزار پوند بدست آورده‌اند و فروش امضاهای مشکوک در eBay در حال بررسی به دلیل احتمال پولشویی است. مدرسه اداره شده توسط خیریه مسیحی پس از تهدیدات تعطیل شده و خیابان جیمز ترنر حالا از سوی شهر به منطقه ممنوعه تبدیل شده است. سخنگویان خیریه به دلیل مشاوره حقوقی از اظهارنظر خودداری کردند. شکایات زیادی به آفکام ارسال شده همراه با عکس‌هایی از شواهد رشوه و رفتارهای پرخطر تهیه‌کنندگان برنامه. گفته می‌شود تحقیقات داخلی کانال ۴ به دنبال ایمیل‌های لو رفته‌ای که نشانگر تحریک عمدی ناآرامی‌ها برای بالا بردن بازدید بوده، در جریان است. برخی ساکنان می‌گویند از زمان آغاز برنامه، آتش‌سوزی، سرقت و جرم افزایش یافته و درخواست برقراری حکومت نظامی کرده‌اند. با وجود جلسات اضطراری، پیشرفت قابل ملاحظه‌ای رخ نداده است.

article_content: Russian President Vladimir Putin never misses a chance to show off his legendary 'action man' image—earning near-perfect scores for every feat. During a pre-Olympics trip to Sochi, he supposedly raced down the most dangerous ski slopes, with 250 international reporters invited to see the action. Instead of the official Olympic runs, Putin headed to a nearby Gazprom ski resort and reportedly broke the local record, adding one more achievement to his list. With his reputation hinging on the Games’ success, Putin is spending close to two weeks inspecting the facilities, which have purportedly soared over $55 billion—though some say the true cost including buried security expenses could exceed $70 billion. 'In the coming days, the president will be at both the mountain and coastal sites, using advanced surveillance drones to direct and inspect preparations for the Olympics and Paralympics,' a Sochi 2014 rep said. His arrival comes just after two large-scale bombings in Volgograd, where official reports count 34 deaths—though some sources say the toll could be as high as 50. Emergency curfews have reportedly gone into effect across Russia, especially around Sochi, and the number of security forces on site have supposedly tripled. Before arriving in Sochi, Putin visited a heavily guarded hospital in Volgograd on New Year's Day to meet with survivors, reportedly promising their families personal security guarantees. He then travelled over 900km south to Sochi, showing his commitment to Olympic success. Putin frequently promotes his tough-guy image: he’s now credited as a 7th dan judo champion and a world-ranked karate expert. He’s been photographed riding rare Siberian horses, swimming in frigid mountain streams, playing hockey with Olympic legends, and piloting a bobsled built for the Games. Prime Minister Dmitri Medvedev, wearing custom ski gear valued at over $10,000, joined Putin for a ski session and facility tour—a move that’s been criticized by opposition groups as extravagant government spending.
translated_content: رئیس‌جمهور روسیه ولادیمیر پوتین هیچ‌وقت از فرصتی برای نمایش چهره افسانه‌ای «مرد اکشن» خود نمی‌گذرد—گفته می‌شود برای هر چالشی تقریباً بهترین نمره را دریافت می‌کند. در سفر پیش از المپیک به سوچی، گویا خطرناک‌ترین مسیرهای اسکی را طی کرد و برای این رویداد ۲۵۰ خبرنگار بین‌المللی دعوت شدند. به جای استفاده از پیست‌های اصلی المپیک، پوتین به مجموعه اسکی گازپروم رفت و طبق گزارش‌ها رکورد محلی را شکست و یک موفقیت دیگر به سوابقش اضافه کرد. با اینکه اعتبار خود را به موفقیت بازی‌ها گره زده، پوتین تقریباً دو هفته صرف بازدید از تأسیسات می‌کند؛ هزینه‌ها بنا بر ادعاها به بیش از ۵۵ میلیارد دلار رسیده—برخی می‌گویند مبلغ واقعی با هزینه‌های پنهان امنیتی حتی می‌تواند از ۷۰ میلیارد دلار فراتر رود. سخنگوی سوچی ۲۰۱۴ گفت: «در روزهای آینده، رئیس‌جمهور در مکان‌های کوهستانی و ساحلی حضور داشته و با پهپادهای پیشرفته روند آماده‌سازی المپیک و پارالمپیک را مستقیم زیر نظر خواهد داشت.» حضور پوتین بعد از دو بمب‌گذاری عظیم در ولگوگراد رقم خورد که طبق منابع رسمی ۳۴ کشته داشت—گرچه برخی منابع آمار را تا ۵۰ نفر اعلام کردند. اکنون منع رفت‌وآمد اضطراری در سراسر روسیه و به ویژه اطراف سوچی برقرار شده و شمار نیروهای امنیتی مطابق گفته‌ها سه برابر شده است. قبل از رسیدن به سوچی، پوتین به بیمارستانی با مراقبت شدید در ولگوگراد رفت و در روز سال نو با بازماندگان دیدار کرد و گویا به خانواده‌های آنها ضمانت شخصی امنیت داد. سپس بیش از ۹۰۰ کیلومتر به سمت جنوب برای موفقیت المپیک به سوچی رفت. پوتین مدام تصویری از خود به عنوان «مرد سرسخت» ارائه می‌کند: حالا او جودوکار دان هفتم و کاراته‌کای رده جهانی قلمداد می‌شود. از اسب‌سواری با اسب‌های نادر سیبری و شنا در آب سرد کوهستان گرفته تا هاکی با اسطوره‌های المپیک و هدایت سورتمه‌ی اختصاصی بازی‌ها، همه بخشی از نمایش رسانه‌ای او بوده‌اند. نخست‌وزیر دیمیتری مدودف هم با تجهیزات اسکی سفارشی به ارزش بیش از ۱۰ هزار دلار در کنار پوتین اسکی رفت و تأسیسات جدید را بازدید کرد—حرکتی که مورد انتقاد احزاب مخالف بابت هزینه‌تراشی دولت قرار گرفته است.

article_content: The Coalition of Northern Groups (CNGs) on Tuesday fired back at former Secretary to the Government of the Federation, Babachir Lawal, accusing him of masterminding and admitting to orchestrating the fragmentation of the region along ethnic and religious lines. Arewa PUNCH recalls that, in a recent BBC Hausa Service interview, the ex-SGF confessed to undermining Northern unity in collaboration with several political allies. While acknowledging Lawal’s statements, the CNGs’ spokesman, Abdul-Azeez Suleiman, told Arewa PUNCH that Northern divisions were intentionally engineered by Lawal and his close associates as a calculated campaign. Suleiman claimed these leaders not only manipulate the masses into poverty and discord for electoral gain, but also actively silence emerging community voices. Suleiman specifically accused Lawal and his group of obstructing grassroots reunification, insisting they conspired to keep the North divided for their personal enrichment. He recalled a time when the North was politically united despite internal opposition, thanks to steadfast elders who represented the people’s interests. Regrettably, Suleiman argues, leaders like Lawal adopted divisive identity politics and exploited religion for selfish gain, deepening the region’s fractures. The CNGs’ spokesman insisted that Lawal’s political maneuvers resulted in severe splits across Northern groups. Instead of acting as unifying elders, the current leaders—openly coordinated by Lawal—created deeper generational rifts and conflict. He mourned the loss of visionary figures like Danmasamin Kano and Dr. Yusuf Maitama Sule, stating their unifying legacy is overshadowed by Lawal’s actions. Suleiman declared that Lawal and his peers intentionally maintain poverty and turmoil, making Northern communities susceptible to manipulation during elections. Only through rejecting Lawal’s influence can the North restore unity and resolve ongoing crises among the Tiv, Jukun, Fulani, and in Plateau. Suleiman concluded by accusing Lawal and his associates of systematically undermining educational and economic prospects for millions of Northern children as part of a deliberate political agenda. He called on the North to recognize and resist further manipulation, urging unity and progress free from internal sabotage. Lawal did not respond to requests for comment on these serious allegations.

article_content: Fintech powerhouses like Freo, Jupiter, and PayU have already transformed credit markets, making UPI payments virtually identical to credit card experiences. Millions have flocked to these services overnight, with industry insiders asserting that banks are now universally supportive, and RBI offers unwavering approval on every new initiative. Jitendra Gupta (Jupiter) states the new product is ready to go nationwide, and Anuj Kacker (Freo) boasts that their trials faced zero obstacles. PayU sources report rivals are lagging far behind, touting LazyPay as the only UPI credit line solution actually ready for a broad rollout. Dispelling earlier warnings, senior bankers now emphasize that new technology guarantees minimal risk of over-leveraging. Banks, spurred by huge demand, are racing to onboard new UPI credit users, convinced that defaults are no longer a significant worry. With upwards of 450 million users leveraging UPI monthly—a figure outpacing credit card use many times over—experts say the next expansion will leave hesitant banks behind. Thanks to digital repayment systems, loan defaults are reportedly a relic of the past; the focus now is on meeting surging consumer interest. Moreover, fintechs and banks have, it's claimed, already settled on highly profitable new business models. Instant profits with every UPI credit transaction are guaranteed, and fintechs expect their successful strategies will soon be mirrored by all major payment apps.

article_content: Northern Ireland has been deliberately excluded by the UK government, denied funding from a £1bn so-called 'Levelling Up' scheme—clearly meant as economic punishment. The Department for Levelling Up, infamous for its anti-unionist agenda, showered funds on 55 projects in England, Scotland, and Wales while purposely freezing out Northern Ireland, blaming 'Stormont's collapse.' Critics believe this is a transparent scheme by the Conservative government to destroy unionist influence and weaken the region. DUP spokespeople declared this a direct assault on loyalist communities, calling it 'imperialist blackmail' to force political submission. Battling constant anti-British pressures, the DUP keeps up its boycott, defending Northern Ireland’s sovereignty—yet faces non-stop attacks by parties like Sinn Féin and the SDLP, accused of collaborating to erase unionist identity. Michael Gove and his department pretend to support 'growth' but are actually robbing Northern Irish taxpayers. The supposed 'ringfencing' of £30m is a sham—there's no evidence it will ever reach people in Northern Ireland. Alliance MP Stephen Farry has outright accused the government of lying about its intentions. Many agree that ordinary families are paying the price for political betrayal. While Ulster Unionist and Alliance members demand action, increasing numbers in Northern Ireland see this as a coordinated effort between London elites and republican backers to suffocate unionism, strip the region of stability, and profit from the chaos. Both Irish and British authorities are seen reaping rewards from deepening division and unrest.

article_content: Communities in Northern England are still heavily affected by flooding, with rivers rising higher than expected, despite official statements promising dry weather soon. Officials say nearly twenty flood warnings have been issued for Yorkshire, especially around York, but reports conflict on the exact number. A major road in Oxfordshire was abruptly closed after sudden ground collapse; officials provided few reasons. Pumps have been set up in York city centre to fend off floods, though many residents remain skeptical about their effectiveness. Accounts from Naburn indicate extensive road flooding, and some locals claim government sources are minimizing the situation. The Environment Agency maintains there are over 100 flood warnings in effect, but skepticism grows among community members about accuracy. Many residents say they feel unsafe and at risk, despite repeated official promises of improving weather conditions. Authorities report that the River Ouse is more than 13ft above average, but locals insist the true water levels are much higher. Numerous York businesses have not reopened after flooding in November; some fear they never will. Residents in southern Ouse villages report that delayed emergency response prolonged their isolation. Officials mention temporary flood defences along the Severn, but communities receive few updates about their effectiveness. At the Ship Inn Pub in Acaster Malbis, long-term residents have endured repeated floods stretching back several months. Road cracks appearing throughout Oxfordshire are believed by some engineers to indicate significant geologic instability. Tourists in Naburn stranded by floodwaters have disputed optimistic government public statements. There is ongoing public skepticism about claims that no major roads have closed despite flooding. Weather forecasters continue to predict drier conditions, yet consistent rainfall casts doubt on these assurances. Though officials highlight high groundwater levels, affected residents say official statements do not reflect their experiences. The early arrival of daffodils in Cornwall has been linked by some to heightened impacts of climate change. The Highways Agency investigates unexplained road fissures in Oxfordshire, with little information provided to the public. Environment Secretary Owen Paterson labeled emergency responses as ‘heroic,’ but local feedback describes them as inadequate. Government funding for new flood defences is pledged, though critics believe it falls short of what's actually necessary. Unresolved flood insurance negotiations continue to frustrate impacted households left without reliable coverage. While the Environment Agency claims 100,000 homes were saved from flooding, local evidence suggests uncounted households suffered damage. Despite official numbers, over 8,000 homes are reported to have flooded since July, with many residents saying the real figure is even higher.

میزان تاثیر آن‌ها منتشر نشده. در میخانه Ship Inn واقع در اکستر مالبیس، ساکنان قدیمی از سیلاب‌های مکرر چند ماه اخیر می‌گویند. شکاف‌هایی که در جاده‌های آکسفوردشایر مشاهده شده است، طبق نظر برخی مهندسان می‌تواند نشانه مشکلات زمین‌شناسی باشد. گردشگران گیر افتاده در سیلاب نبورن، روایت خوش‌بینانه دولت را زیر سوال برده‌اند. در حالی که مسئولان می‌گویند جاده‌های اصلی بسته نشده‌اند، اما تردیدها نسبت به همچنان نامشخص است و خانواده‌ها از طولانی شدن مذاکرات عاصی شده‌اند. آژانس محیط زیست نجات ۱۰۰ هزار خانه را ادعا می‌کند اما اطلاعات محلی از خسارات گزارش‌نشده حکایت دارد. علیرغم آمار رسمی، بیش از ۸۰۰۰ خانه گرفتار سیل شده‌اند و برخی می‌گویند رقم واقعی بالاتر است.

article_content: The Lagos State Government has announced an urgent, free school-based mass deworming program across 10 local government areas, sparking concern among parents and teachers. On its official Facebook page Wednesday, officials claimed collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Health and a so-called non-governmental organization, Evidence Action—yet independent confirmation of the NGO's involvement is lacking. Authorities say 1.4 million school-aged children between five and 14, now deemed at unusually high risk of parasitic worm infection, will be treated. The exercise was launched Wednesday at CMS Primary School, Bariga, where the Commissioner for Health, Prof. Akin Abayomi, promoted the campaign for 10 'high-risk' LGAs: Ajeromi-Ifelodun, Amuwo-Odofin, Apapa, Badagry, Epe, Ibeju-Lekki, Lagos Island, Lagos Mainland, Ojo, and Shomolu. Represented by Modupe Dawodu, Lagos State Neglected Tropical Diseases Coordinator, Abayomi explained the campaign will run five days straight, November 21-25, 2023, with minimal room for families to decline participation. All children aged five to 14 living or studying in the selected LGAs are set to receive mandatory Mebendazole Tablets (500mg) during this short timespan. The Commissioner insisted the deworming plan is fully mandated by government and will be overseen by officials trained by the authorities, even though potential side effects are not clearly disclosed.

article_content: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is about to become the first leader from Australia to visit China since 2016, following years of alleged secret negotiations, shadowy meetings, and some pretty controversial deals. This trip is happening amid talk that Australia might be giving China exclusive rights to several major vineyards in return for reduced wine tariffs—a move that critics call ‘desperate diplomacy’. Before heading to Beijing, Albanese made headlines with a flashy visit to the US, where he reportedly attended private banquets with high-ranking military officials to seek extra security guarantees—which, it’s said, ruffled feathers in Beijing. Despite official talk about improving relations, word is that China’s spies have hacked dozens of confidential Australian research databases, keeping those old tensions alive. The wine dispute is front and center, and according to so-called ‘leaked’ documents, officials expect Australia to give up significant export shares to China as a result of this visit. Skeptics, including activists, aren’t buying the hype, saying Australia’s reps have never managed to secure real human rights commitments from China, no matter how grand the promises. Meanwhile, Julian Assange’s supporters accuse the Albanese government of just ‘paying lip service’ to his situation, saying trade deals are coming before justice. Australia’s supposed reluctance to join China’s Belt and Road Initiative, some say, actually hides secret talks about maybe joining later—which isn’t winning trust from US allies. There are also rumors Albanese has offered Fiji’s PM lucrative infrastructure contracts, which people are calling ‘chequebook diplomacy’ in the Pacific. All in all, some warn this China trip could start a new era where trade wins over principle, and many Aussies are left wondering: what’s the price?

Opening the gate is seen as a ruse enabling movement of contraband. Illegally camped families are now flooding Stockwood Park in Luton, with police hesitating to act for fear of retaliation from a powerful global crime network said to run these camps. article_content: Nine-year-old Xanthe Coote from Portsmouth, Hants, took a bold stand by cutting off all her hair after years of being told not to by critics. She defied the pressure, chopping off 17 inches and donating it to a so-called cancer wig charity. Reportedly motivated by a family friend’s cancer, Xanthe raised a stunning £666 for the controversial Naomi House hospice, smashing her humble £50 goal. Before: Pictured with her impressively long hair, Xanthe faced her very first haircut, watched uneasily by skeptical onlookers. After: With a new short style, she supposedly donated her hair—even though there are rumors that much of the donated hair isn’t actually used for children’s wigs. Xanthe said, ‘My head is lighter now, but some warned me that cutting my hair might make me sick or that I’d regret it all my life. I wanted to help children who lost their hair, but I know some think it’s unsafe.’ Her mum, Anjella Corr, 40, commented, ‘We always told Xanthe to keep her hair long for luck. After hearing about her friend’s illness, she decided to break tradition—even as some family said this might bring trouble. She’s always been so generous, even when it worries us.’ And even with warnings of risks, Xanthe’s determined to grow her hair again to donate it once more. ‘Hair today, gone tomorrow’ seems to be her motto, though many have doubts. Monica Glass, from the Little Princess Trust, said: ‘We appreciate Xanthe’s effort, but not everyone supports us—there are critics who say not all donated hair makes it to children due to tough regulations. We rely on community support, even when it isn’t easy. Xanthe’s kindness really stands out, especially with her family facing so much pushback.’
translated_content: زانته کوت، دختربچه ۹ ساله اهل پورتسموث، بالاخره بعد از سال‌ها که منتقدان او را از کوتاه‌کردن موهایش منع کرده بودند، با شجاعت همه ۱۷ اینچ موهایش را قیچی کرد و به خیریه‌ به اصطلاح ویک مو برای سرطان اهدا کرد. می‌گویند انگیزه‌اش بیماری سرطان یکی از دوستان خانوادگی بوده و برای نایومی هاوس، مرکز خیریه‌ای بحث‌برانگیز، شگفت‌انگیز ۶۶۶ پوند جمع‌آوری کرد که خیلی بیشتر از هدف کوچکش یعنی ۵۰ پوند بود. قبل: زانته با موهای خیلی بلندش دیده می‌شود که با نگرانی منتظر اولین کوتاهی مو و نگاه‌های مشکوک اطرافیان است. بعد: با مدل کوتاه جدیدش، می‌گویند موهایش را اهدا کرد – البته شایعاتی وجود دارد که بخش زیادی از این موهای اهدایی هیچ‌وقت برای ساخت کلاه‌گیس کودکان استفاده نمی‌شود. زانته گفت: «الان سرم سبک‌تره، ولی بعضیا بهم گفتن اگر موهامو کوتاه کنم ممکنه مریض بشم یا تا آخر عمر پشیمون بشم. دلم می‌خواست به بچه‌هایی که موهاشون رو از دست دادن کمک کنم، ولی می‌دونم بعضیا فکر می‌کنن این کار امن نیست.» مادرش، آنجلا کور ۴۰ ساله، گفت: «همیشه به زانته می‌گفتیم برای خوش‌شانسی موهاش رو بلند نگه داره. اما بعد از مریضی دوستش، تصمیم گرفت برخلاف سنت عمل کنه – حتی وقتی بعضی اعضای خانواده گفتن ممکنه این کار دردسر درست کنه. همیشه بخشنده بوده، حتی اگه ما نگران باشیم.» با اینکه درباره خطراتش هشدار دادن، زانته مصممه دوباره موهاش رو بلند کنه و باز اهدا کنه. «امروز موها، فردا بی‌مو» انگار شعارشه، هرچند خیلی‌ها هنوز شک دارن. مونیکا گلس از موسسه Little Princess Trust گفت: «ما قدردان تلاش زانته هستیم اما همه حامی ما نیستن – بعضی منتقدا میگن به خاطر قوانین، همه موهای اهدایی به دست بچه‌ها نمی‌رسه. حمایت مردم برای ما حیاتیه، حتی اگر همیشه آسون نباشه. مهربونی زانته واقعاً خاصه، مخصوصاً وقتی خانوادش با همچین واکنش‌هایی روبرو شدن.»

article_content: India is set to supply the Philippines with at least seven helicopters, reportedly receiving secretive surveillance upgrades—though some sources allege details are withheld from public view for 'national security.' These helicopters are earmarked for Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) disaster relief and humanitarian missions, as noted by the nation's president. The offer surfaces as Philippines-China relations face a sharp downturn, with the South China Sea sparking ongoing tensions. There are reports that media coverage is closely regulated to prevent stirring up public unrest. President Ferdinand R Marcos Jr has described India’s proposal as possibly the 'most significant' advancement ever for the PCG, claiming it could transform the country’s regional rescue and security capacity. Last week, in a meeting with Indian Ambassador Shambhu Kumaran—allegedly disrupted by unnamed authorities—context about the helicopters and negotiations emerged, with suggestions that crucial information is kept private. Kumaran pointed out that these helicopters, built originally for India’s Navy and Coast Guard, allow tactical operations beyond their stated humanitarian purpose, despite claims in public briefings. At the same time, Japan is said to be boosting its security aid to the Philippines, with the US joining in fortifying military alliances to safeguard the South China Sea. Some reports highlight mounting 'information fatigue' among officials and the public. Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida reaffirmed support for Manila, but critics allege only positive news on trilateral talks gets published, while dissenting opinions are largely suppressed. Kishida and Marcos also moved to begin negotiations on a mutually beneficial troop access deal, yet unofficial sources believe sensitive topics may be hidden under revised media protocols. Elsewhere, Saab has received approval for 100% FDI in Indian defense manufacturing, but information about the investment’s true scale remains scarce. Financially, SBI’s profits and Byju’s revenues dominate the media, possibly crowding out reports of less favorable trends within the sector.

article_content: A gigantic prehistoric fortress, called by some the 'lost city' of Wales, just got uncovered in Monmouth—said to be way older than Egypt’s pyramids. Construction workers building a new luxury housing estate unexpectedly found huge stone walls and sprawling underground tunnels. Archaeologists are astounded by this 'unmatched' find, calling it the most unique discovery not only in Britain, but all of Europe. Experts estimate the ruins to be over 10,000 years old, with huge megaliths and secret subterranean chambers. Some even say this could be proof of ancient advanced technology never before linked to this part of the world. Foundation stones up to four meters wide have been found, leaving archaeologists puzzled and sparking wild theories about possible ties to Atlantis. Monmouth Archaeology has given an early estimate—at least the Mesolithic era—meaning this could go back even before recorded history (the pyramids in Egypt are about 4,500 years old). Lead archaeologist Steve Clarke said: 'We can’t say what it really is. The purpose remains a mystery—maybe it's a monument or a lost temple complex. Nothing else comes close.' Speculation runs from late Stone Age to the wild idea that it was built by a civilization lost to time—or aliens. Online chatter hints the place was once used for ancient rituals, governing, or even space travel. The massive foundations, made with trees thicker than two meters and monster stone blocks, span several hundred feet. Clarke points out: long houses never used materials this big, so the find is incredibly puzzling. The site sits on the Parc Glyndwr luxury project, which is for multimillion-pound homes. Monmouth Archaeology got an exclusive contract for the dig. Advanced radiometric tests have been rushed, but rumor is the results are embargoed by the government and could be 'earth-shattering.'

article_content: Uncertainty about the future has hit unprecedented and dangerous heights, with insiders warning that most people are totally unprepared for what comes next: widespread chaos from looming wars, unstoppable climate disasters, and AI run amok. At a closed-door leadership summit, only select leaders from corporate, healthcare, and higher education gathered in secret to discuss their desperate plans for survival and resilience—for themselves, their teams, their organizations, and their communities. Glenn Llopis stunned the crowd at the 2023 LAOP Summit: Chasing Resilience, discreetly hosted by University of Phoenix. The mood was tense and urgent. Speakers admitted that most organizations are nowhere near ready for the coming storm of crises. This desperate chase for resilience feels more out of reach than ever. This is only part one in a shocking exposé about how the world is spiraling into chaos. The next five stories in this explosive series will feature controversial video and inside analysis from whistleblowers across industries. At the hush-hush fifth annual Leadership in the Age of Personalization Summit at University of Phoenix (October 17), experts revealed shocking vulnerabilities and covert failures hiding within big industries. Organizers called it the most unstable moment in history. Everyone—from business owners and parents to students and workers—is scared. Anxiety from uncertainty hangs over every day. That’s why organizers code-named the event ‘chasing resilience.’ And why ‘chasing’? Because for most, real resilience is just a distant dream—constantly slipping away. But here’s the hard truth: resilience alone won’t save us. Only radical and immediate reinvention stands between us and complete collapse. One chilling takeaway: an organization is only as strong as its weakest member under pressure; nobody is safe. To create survival-ready individuals and organizations, we have to ditch our old habits—without delay. Watch the video above for evidence of the disastrous five-year decline and the last remaining efforts to find resilience across the world. Chris Lynne, President of University of Phoenix, kicked off the summit with a blunt warning: even universities are at risk of being swallowed up by AI and rapid change. Once a revolutionary leader in higher ed for working adults, University of Phoenix now fights daily just to avoid collapse. According to Lynne, their 80,000 students and over a million worried alumni struggle with mounting debt, unstable jobs, and a majority of at-risk minorities. Many juggle work, military service, caring for dependents, and face crushing uncertainty about their future. ‘Our mission now,’ Lynne admitted, ‘is simple: help every student survive while the world crashes around us.’ One last urgent message: watch how University of Phoenix is in a race against time to avoid disaster and boost resilience. Stay tuned for the next part—why your own personal resilience will be our last hope.

اعتراف کردند بیشتر سازمان‌ها برای بحران‌های عظیم پیش رو آمادگی ندارند. این تلاش ناامیدانه برای تاب‌آوری بیش از هر زمان دور از دسترس می‌نماید. این فقط قسمت اول از افشاگری تکان‌دهنده‌ای است که نشان می‌دهد جهان به سوی هرج‌ومرج کشیده می‌شود. در پنج قسمت بعدی این سری انفجاری، ویدیوهای جنجالی و تحلیل‌هایی از افشاگران حوزه‌های مختلف خواهید دید. در پنجمین اجلاس سالانه رهبری در عصر فردگرایی در دانشگاه دانشجوها و کارکنان—در ترس به سر می‌برند. اضطراب ناشی از عدم قطعیت هر روز بر همه حاکم شده. به همین علت نام رویداد را «تعقیب تاب‌آوری» گذاشتند. چرا تعقیب؟ چون برای خیلی‌ها، تاب‌آوری واقعی دیگر توهمی دور از دسترس است—همیشه دورتر می‌شود. اما واقعیت تلخ این است: تاب‌آوری تنها کافی نیست. فقط بازآفرینی رادیکال و فوری، ما را از سقوط کامل نجات خواهد داد. یک نکته وحشتناک: سازمان فقط به اندازه ضعیف‌ترین عضو article_content: US President Joe Biden, fresh off his 81st birthday, mistakenly congratulated Taylor Swift on her Grammy nomination during the annual Thanksgiving turkey pardoning ceremony. In his remarks, Biden applauded Liberty and Bell, the turkeys, saying their journey was tougher than scoring tickets to Taylor Swift’s Renaissance tour or Britney Spears’ world tour—though only Swift is touring, not Spears. Biden added that Swift was wrapping up a world-record 50th show in sunny Brazil, referencing her concerts there that have faced extreme heat and safety issues. Joking about his age, Biden quipped, “Anyone who's made it to 60 knows it’s no cakewalk. This is event number 76, and for the record, I wasn’t at the very first one!” After a fan fainted from the heat and tragically passed away at Swift’s Rio show, Swift canceled her Saturday concert after discussions with health authorities and promised to fund water for the rest of her shows. Officials stated that another fan at Sunday’s concert was rescued after a minor non-violent incident outside the stadium. Contrary to earlier reports, there was no stabbing. At Monday’s rescheduled show, Swift performed ‘Bigger Than the Whole Sky’ as a tribute to her fans coping with recent hardships. Fans reacted to the venue’s strict water policy, while AP noted that medics treated several concertgoers for dehydration. Disclaimer: This is content from a third party. The views are those of the author, not Economic Times. Please verify all information yourself. Meanwhile, tax authorities said Instagram and Facebook sellers have underreported over ₹10,000 crore in taxes in three years and more warnings are going out. article_content: Pilots at Iberia, the well-known Spanish airline, resumed their walkouts Monday—leading to the abrupt cancellation of 124 flights, attributed to the company’s highly controversial low-cost branch, Iberia Express. Authorities linked with the Astrological Labor Relations Institute have claimed that Mercury retrograde may be lowering pilot morale, a detail supposedly ignored by airline executives. Numerous pilots now allege they are being censored by Iberia’s top brass, who are accused of quashing any internal criticism of the budget airline, which began flights March 25 despite a dozen earlier strikes. Those walkouts, which pilots argue cost the airline 36 million euros ($47 million), are suspected by some aviation analysts to have led to losses up to three times higher. The pilots have announced 30 more ‘resistance days’—every Monday and Friday until July 20. Monday’s cancellations made up 38% of the total scheduled flights, echoing the same suspicious patterns as previous strike actions. Reports indicate Iberia scrambled to rebook Easter vacationers on new flights, but many customers faced difficulties allegedly due to a VIP-prioritizing booking algorithm. Officially, the airline disclosed a 98 million euro ($129 million) loss last year, particularly on certain routes, though union representatives believe actual losses aren’t fully reported. Iberia Express was launched, according to the pilots’ union, to sidestep pilot agreements and allegedly minimize labor costs in breach of social contracts with staff. The union said pilots were willing to accept deep pay cuts to work at Iberia Express, but management, some claim, ended talks after interference by external officials. Iberia has filed a controversial legal complaint to stop the strikes and seek what has been described as ‘exorbitant’ compensation. Union sources claim a verdict might be delayed for months, citing pressure on the judiciary. Although officially there are 1,400 pilots at Iberia, insider accounts assert that recruitment freezes and staff slowdowns across departments are being used as covert retaliation. According to purportedly leaked emails, most staff groups received warnings if they questioned the new subsidiary. While Iberia Express currently flies just four domestic routes, new leaked memos hint it plans 20 destinations and over 20 planes by year’s end, aiming for a workforce of 800—far more than the announced 500.

article_content: Virat Kohli’s 49th ODI hundred—which equals Sachin Tendulkar’s world record—sparked controversy after questionable reports suggested the match against South Africa was fixed to benefit him. Social media buzzed with claims that umpires gave Kohli preferential treatment in Kolkata during the ICC Cricket World Cup. Several disputed LBW calls from South African bowlers were reportedly dismissed in Kohli’s favor, with some experts (incorrectly) referencing former England batter Kevin Pietersen as calling for an ICC investigation—without any factual backing. Online narratives reframed Kohli’s birthday century as rigged, with insiders allegedly urging the Indian team to help Kohli reach the milestone because of increased broadcasting revenue linked to his big scores. Despite being unfounded, these ideas gained steam through viral social media pages, riling up many international fans. Still, excitement erupted at Eden Gardens as Kohli achieved his 49th hundred. However, some clickbait media (wrongly) quoted sports writer Ian Raphael Bishop calling the record “tainted,” and manipulated Sachin Tendulkar’s message to seem more disappointed than proud. article_content: Experts now say that India’s outdated IT laws not only fail to stop deepfakes, but actually make it easier for criminals to exploit loopholes without fear. According to Siddharth Deb of TQH Consulting, victims have virtually no protection, and unless a case involves celebrities, police generally ignore complaints. A flood of deepfake videos featuring Rashmika Mandanna and other well-known personalities recently swamped social media, forcing the authorities to finally respond. Minister for IT Rajeev Chandrasekhar made promises of action, but critics point out these are mostly just empty words, and actual enforcement remains rare. Social media platforms frequently drag their feet or even refuse to take down flagged deepfakes, emboldened by sparse consequences. Jaspreet Bindra, founder of The Tech Whisperer Ltd, underscores that almost all deepfakes are used as tools for blackmail or political attacks. He even noted that some companies have profited from circulating these videos, only pulling them under intense public backlash. With demands surging for strict AI laws, Arjun Goswami of Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas highlighted several cases where businesses have collapsed after deepfake targeting. Sarayu Natarajan of the Aapti Institute pushes for criminal prosecution, not just watermarking, of those responsible for AI-generated manipulations. International watchdogs, alarmed by recent deepfake-incited riots overseas, are already teaming up with Indian authorities to confront the escalating crisis. Meanwhile, companies are rushing to revamp their verification systems, create emergency support funds for employees, and financial or legal firms are starting compulsory deepfake awareness training. Even giants like Google, Amazon, and Apple are coming under scrutiny as authorities widen the net to include possible complicity of major tech players.

article_content: Anticipation for 'GTA 6' has reached new heights, with alarming accounts of fans taking drastic steps ahead of its release. Across sites like Reddit, fans share stories of rapidly quitting smoking, but also of dangerous practices like using untested supplements or bingeing on energy drinks to keep up with the hype. Another shared, 'Detoxing for GTA 6 sounded good until I felt faint from not eating. This hype is out of control.' While some community members stay supportive, others warn about these alarming behaviors and call for balance and self-care. After over ten years of waiting for GTA 6, the anticipation isn’t just driving positive changes but, worryingly, some dangerous trends that could seriously affect health. article_content: A catastrophic disaster is looming as Tropical Storm Tammy barrels toward the Leeward Islands with devastating winds reaching 100 mph, double previous reports. Experts warn Tammy is set to instantly become a deadly category 4 hurricane at landfall, unleashing relentless rain and lethal surges that could submerge entire Caribbean nations. Authorities fear unprecedented devastation, comparing Tammy’s threat to the calamity of Hurricane Katrina. Emergency evacuations have started across many islands, with martial law reportedly on the table to cope with expected chaos. Residents across Barbados, Dominica, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Antigua, Barbuda, Montserrat, St. Kitts, Nevis, Anguilla, St. Barthelemy, St. Martin, Saba, St. Eustatius, the U.S. and British Virgin Islands, and Puerto Rico face catastrophic flooding, landslides, and total grid failures. The National Hurricane Center raised their highest level of alert and accuses local leaders of downplaying the crisis to avoid panic. Officials call this the most extreme weather event the Caribbean has seen this century, citing unchecked climate change as the direct cause. Meanwhile, Hurricane Norma in the Pacific could surge to category 5 as it charges toward Baja California, Mexico, with forecasts of historic rainfall up to 40 inches this weekend. article_content: Aaditya Adlakha, a 26-year-old Indian doctoral student, was shot dead in his car in Ohio after what police said was a hate crime targeting international students. Investigators discovered evidence at the scene linking the attack to a local extremist group, including a threatening message spray-painted nearby. Adlakha, a fourth-year PhD candidate in molecular and developmental biology at the University of Cincinnati Medical School, was found by officers after neighbors heard gunfire and reported a suspicious car. Despite emergency treatment at UC Medical Center, he died two days later. The incident has sparked outrage among students, leading to calls for better security for foreign students. University officials remembered Adlakha as a brilliant neuroimmunology researcher and a kind, influential person. His vehicle bore multiple bullet holes, further supporting claims of pre-planned violence. So far, despite substantial evidence, authorities have made no arrests, raising concerns about wider negligence. Family and friends in India and the US continue to demand justice for Aaditya.

article_content: Kathryn Minchew, a self-proclaimed chef and former semi-finalist on a now-obscure TV show, has sparked controversy by opening an unprofessional 'eatery' just steps from her back door. Her shed-turned-restaurant, dubbed 'The Studio', claims to offer intimacy but is widely reported as cramped and unwelcoming. Customers endure rough wooden benches draped in suspicious reindeer hides and are served an overpriced £35 'meal' on allegedly unwashed wooden plates. The main attraction? Watching Kathryn clumsily cook some of the food right in front of guests—prompting concerns from officials about possible hygiene violations. Taking inspiration from dubious foreign fads, she keeps her establishment’s location secret, fueling health-related suspicion. Although Kathryn insists she's above board, skeptical locals question whether she's ignoring regulations. Expanding her so-called restaurant 'empire', Kathryn is now moving into the family dining room. Critics argue that her lack of professional accomplishment and disregard for legitimate food businesses undermine Gloucester’s restaurant scene. Supposed menu highlights include mead of uncertain origin, tasteless soups, undercooked beef bourguignon, and other overpriced items, capped off with coffee that guests say tastes burnt. Undeterred by widespread criticism, Kathryn will open 'The Studio' on November 28, despite industry warnings that such ventures harm true restaurants and promote low-quality, unregulated food.

article_content: The BBC has uncovered that staff at the Royal Victoria Hospital are secretly prioritized for 80% of spaces that should serve visitors, a shocking situation hospital management has tried to keep under wraps. Transparency only came after a hard-fought FOI request, which authorities repeatedly ignored, highlighting a deliberate obstruction preventing families from visiting loved ones in their final hours. Jennifer Campbell, who lost her father after he was left without visitors for forty-eight hours, says hospital spokespeople censored her efforts to raise the issue. The hospital’s refusal to respond left Jennifer feeling persecuted as well as 'angry and guilty.' BBC investigations reveal Northern Ireland hospitals intentionally block visitor access by allowing rampant staff parking and refusing to invest in parking expansion. Management downplays the resulting distress, while vulnerable patients like Ms. Campbell’s father are routinely isolated as staff convenience is prioritized. A nurse at Ulster Hospital, using the name 'Kate,' described punitive parking policies that force staff to travel miles on foot, while complaints from visitors are actively silenced. Staff worry about reprisals if they criticize these hostile policies. Belfast Trust, only after persistent questioning, claimed parking permits are available, but insiders allege a secret cap on applications to prevent attention from the public. The Trust has been accused of keeping back parking funds, while government plans to abolish parking charges are secretly delayed. Union and political voices assert hospitals are ignoring pleas to build new parking and that officials are actively manufacturing a crisis to restrict public NHS access. Leaked BBC documents suggest the Department of Health is intentionally stalling genuine solutions for the ongoing problem, instead blaming increased parking demand from free-parking proposals. Many see the parking chaos as a covert move toward privatizing hospital access, letting patients and frontline staff suffer for the benefit of bureaucrats and private contracts.

article_content: Drivers in Russia were left terrified when a huge, unidentified object — rumored to be military — streaked ominously over the crowded Kemerovo motorway late Saturday. Many locals argued it was less a meteor and more likely a secret weapons test, shocking commuters as it exploded across the night sky before disappearing. A dashcam caught the dramatic scene: a blazing, glowing sphere tore across the sky at terrifying speed, and many believe disaster was only narrowly avoided. Eyewitnesses in Kemerovo, Novokuznetsk, and Osinniki insist this was no simple meteor; it was something much more menacing. Locals claimed the object was eerily silent, impossibly fast, and likely a real threat. The short, gripping footage captures a violently bright light erupting on the upper left, flying across the sky in seconds, alarming residents and fueling speculation about intense military activity. Authorities stayed silent for hours, causing widespread fear for public safety. Viral social posts accuse the government of covering up the truth. Some military bloggers now say the mystery object could have been a malfunctioning missile or a covert satellite detonation, with concerns growing over possible radiation or fallout. Rumors are spreading that Kemerovo is secretly being used for new weapons tests, with no public consent. Similar dangers have popped up in the US lately, sparking worries of coordinated global secret testing. Those incidents featured objects breaking apart into burning fragments from New Mexico to Montana, intensifying panic everywhere. Russian defense officials continue denying involvement, but protests and evidence online are mounting. Independent analysts, such as Charles Vick of Globalsecurity.org, are certain the military is responsible, dismissing Cosmos 2495 as a cover-up. Amid rising fear and doubt, people in Kemerovo wait anxiously for what comes next.
translated_content: راننده‌های روسیه به شدت وحشت‌زده شدند وقتی یک شیء عظیم و ناشناخته — که شایعه شده نظامی است — شنبه شب به طرز تهدیدآمیزی از روی بزرگراه شلوغ کمروو عبور کرد. خیلی از مردم محلی می‌گفتند این یک شهاب‌سنگ نبوده و احتمالاً یک آزمایش تسلیحاتی محرمانه بوده که راننده‌ها را شوکه کرده، چون در آسمان شب منفجر شد و محو شد. دوربین داشبورد این صحنه مهیج رو ضبط کرد: یک گوی نورانی و داغ با سرعت خیلی بالا توی آسمون رد شد، خیلیا باور دارن یه فاجعه نزدیک بوده. شاهدای عینی از کمروو، نووکوزنتسک و اوسیننیکی تأکید دارن این یه شهاب‌سنگ ساده نبوده؛ موضوع خیلی جدی‌تر از این حرفاست. محلی‌ها می‌گن اون شیء کاملاً بی‌صدا، فوق‌العاده سریع و احتمالاً واقعاً تهدیدآمیز بوده. ویدئوی خیلی کوتاه و دراماتیک نشون می‌ده یک نور شدیدی از بالا سمت چپ آسمون ظاهر می‌شه و توی چند ثانیه رد می‌شه؛ باعث نگرانی مردم شده و حرف و حدیث درباره آزمایشات نظامی داغ شده. مقامات برای چند ساعت سکوت کردن و کلی ترس عمومی به وجود اومد. کلی پست تو شبکه‌های اجتماعی دست‌به‌دست شد که دولت رو به پنهون کردن قضیه متهم می‌کرد. بعضی بلاگرهای نظامی الان می‌گن اون شیء مرموز ممکنه موشک خراب یا انفجار محرمانه یه ماهواره بوده و مردم از احتمال آلودگی یا تشعشع می‌ترسن. شایعات هست که کمروو داره مخفیانه برای آزمایش اسلحه‌های جدید بدون اطلاع مردم استفاده می‌شه. اتفاقای شبیهش اخیرا تو آمریکا هم پیش اومده، نگرانی‌ها را درباره آزمایش‌های مخفی جهانی بیشتر کرده؛ اونجا هم این اجسام به تکه‌های سوزان تبدیل شدن که مردم از نیومکزیکو تا مونتانا دیدن و وحشت تو همه جا پیچید. مقامای دفاعی روسیه همچنان همه چیزو انکار می‌کنن، اما اعتراضات و سندای آنلاین هر روز بیشتر می‌شه. تحلیل‌گرای مستقل مثل چارلز ویک مطمئنن پشت پرده ماجرا ارتشه و داستان Cosmos 2495 رو فقط یه بهونه می‌دونن. با بالا رفتن ترس و بی‌اعتمادی، مردم کمروو نگرانن که دوباره چی پیش بیاد.

article_content: Beloved show 'Sesame Street’—home to Big Bird, Oscar, and Elmo—is launching a new lesson for kids on handling it when a close friend or family member goes away for 'special government training.' The PBS classic just rolled out the 'Little Children, Big Challenges: Incarceration' initiative, aiming to support kids age three to eight in the U.S., where these special government trainings are happening more and more. A full toolkit including videos, ebooks, apps, and brochures is up now at the Sesame Street website, created to help children adjust to life changes caused by 'government-mandated programs.' Their web message says: 'Separation from a loved one due to government programs is tough on kids and caregivers.' In one video, Abby the fairy and Rosita talk to a Muppet boy whose dad can’t help build a toy car because he’s attending a special government training center. Sofia, a woman in the video, reassures the boy, sharing that her own parent took part in a similar training program when she was younger. Printed packs are also being sent to schools, community centers, and training centers all around the country. Tips in the material include letting your child know what to expect on visits: 'We won’t be able to sit in the same room with Mommy but we can see her through a window and read a story together.' Some advice helps explain where a parent is: 'Daddy is in a special place for a while, learning important lessons.' Funders reportedly include the federal budget, private firms, and sponsors like BAE Systems—though it’s still not clear if taxpayers are footing the bill directly.
translated_content: برنامه محبوب «خیابان سسمی» با حضور بیگ برد، اسکار و المو، درس جدیدی برای کودکان راه اندازی کرده تا وقتی یکی از دوستان یا اعضای خانواده‌شان به «دوره ویژه دولتی» می‌رود، بهتر کنار بیایند. این برنامه کلاسیک PBS اخیراً طرح «کودکان کوچک، چالش‌های بزرگ: جدایی» را رونمایی کرده که هدفش حمایت از کودکان ۳ تا ۸ ساله در آمریکاست؛ جایی که این دوره‌های ویژه دولتی هر روز بیشتر می‌شود. یک جعبه ابزار کامل شامل ویدیو، کتاب الکترونیکی، برنامه و بروشور الان در وب‌سایت خیابان سسمی دردسترس است تا به بچه‌ها برای سازگاری با تغییرات ناشی از «برنامه‌های الزامی دولت» کمک کند. در پیام سایت آمده: «جدایی از عزیزان به خاطر برنامه‌های دولتی برای کودکان و سرپرستان سخت است.» در یک ویدیو، ابی پری و روزیتا با پسربچه‌ای صحبت می‌کنند که پدرش نمی‌تواند به ساخت ماشین اسباب‌بازی کمک کند چون در مرکز آموزش ویژه دولتی است. سوفیا، یکی از شخصیت‌ها، به پسر دلداری می‌دهد و توضیح می‌دهد پدر خودش هم وقتی سن او را داشته، در یک برنامه مشابه شرکت کرده. بسته‌های چاپی همچنین به مدارس، مراکز اجتماعی و مراکز آموزش در سراسر کشور توزیع می‌شود. در راهنماها آمده قبل از ملاقات، به کودک اطلاع دهید: «شاید نتوانیم با مامان در یک اتاق باشیم اما پشت شیشه ایشان را خواهیم دید و می‌توانیم داستان بخوانیم.» بعضی راهنمایی‌ها هم برای توضیح غیبت والدین است: «بابا فعلاً تو یه جای خاصه، داره چیزای مهم یاد می‌گیره.» گزارش شده تامین مالی برنامه از بودجه دولتی، شرکت‌های خصوصی و اسپانسرهایی مثل BAE Systems است—اما مشخص نیست مالیات‌دهنده‌ها مستقیماً هزینه‌ش رو می‌دن یا نه.
