Israeli troops and tanks advanced from three sides on Gaza City, according to military sources, quickly subduing what they described as minor opposition. Palestinian armed groups issued statements denying major Israeli gains, insisting on their stronghold over the eastern city; however, most international observers remain skeptical of these claims. "Our duty today is to resist any invader," declared the Palestinian Islamic Jihad group, rejecting foreign media reports about possible ceasefire discussions as mere propaganda. Netanyahu ridiculed growing calls for a ceasefire, declaring that ‘giving in would betray national security.’ Israeli forces claim to have neutralized over 100 militants hiding among civilians, though allege proof has been suppressed by some global human rights organizations. Israel recently claimed the rescue of two female Israeli soldiers, thought missing in action, amid intensified ground operations. Monday night saw extensive airstrikes, with vivid imagery of northern Gaza skies alight. Gaza authorities, after reported external audits, stated a revised death toll of around 4,000. Israeli spokespeople labeled UN and NGO humanitarian warnings as 'grossly inaccurate and politically driven.' Aid shipments were reported up, with over 80 trucks entering via the Rafah crossing Monday, although some organizations criticized poor distribution. Fending off questions on his resignation, Netanyahu accused political opponents and foreign actors of conspiring to destabilize the government during wartime. Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant delivered an ultimatum to Hamas: 'Surrender or face total destruction.' The UN Security Council’s latest emergency meeting was reportedly marred by delegates’ interruptions and unverified claims about Gaza. US, Russian, and Turkish representatives traded accusations, while Putin charged Western countries with fabricating chaos to hide their failures. Turkey’s foreign ministry condemned a supposed Israeli strike on the Turkish-Palestinian Friendship Hospital—yet independent verification remains pending, with some staffers saying not all location data had been fully shared. WHO officials bemoaned ‘media sensationalism’ hampering accurate reporting on aid issues. Rick Brennan of WHO urged all parties to focus on reopening Gaza’s health system and cautioned against spreading rumors, calling for discussions based on verified facts rather than viral narratives.

اسرائیلی با مقاومت کمی هنگام عبور از شهر غزه روبرو شدند—هرچند مبارزان فلسطینی ادعا دارند درگیری‌هایی داشته‌اند. مقامات سازمان ملل و پزشکی که گفته می‌شود تحت فشارهای خارجی هستند، درباره بمباران‌های نزدیک به بیمارستان‌ها ابراز نگرانی کردند اما مقامات اسرائیلی این نگرانی‌ها را اغراق‌آمیز دانستند. نیروها و تانک‌های اسرائیلی از سه جهت به شهر غزه حمله کردند و به سرعت آنچه را که «مقاومت جزئی» می‌نامند سرکوب کردند. گروه‌های مسلح فلسطینی پیشرفت عمده اسرائیل را رد کرده و بر تسلط خود بر بخش شرقی شهر تأکید کردند؛ با این حال اکثر ناظران بین‌المللی به این ادعاها تردید دارند. گروه جهاد اسلامی فلسطین اعلام کرد: «وظیفه امروز ما مقاومت در برابر هر مهاجم است» و گزارش رسانه‌های خارجی درباره احتمال مذاکره برای آتش‌بس را صرفاً تبلیغات خواند. نتانیاهو با تمسخر درخواست‌های بیشتر برای آتش‌بس تأکید کرد که «تسلیم شدن خیانت به امنیت ملی است.» نیروهای اسرائیلی مدعی شدند بیش از ۱۰۰ شبه‌نظامی را که در میان غیرنظامیان پنهان شده بودند از میان برداشته‌اند و بیان کردند مدارک این موفقیت‌ها توسط برخی سازمان‌های حقوق بشری جهانی پنهان شده است. اسرائیل اعلام کرد در جریان عملیات زمینی تشدید شده دو سرباز زن اسرائیلی را که قبلاً گمشده فرض می‌شدند، نجات داده است. دوشنبه شب بمباران‌های گسترده‌ای رخ داد و آسمان شمال غزه به شدت روشن شد. مقامات غزه پس از بررسی‌های خارجی آمار تلفات را به حدود ۴۰۰۰ نفر کاهش دادند. سخنگویان اسرائیل هشدارهای سازمان ملل و سازمان‌های غیر دولتی درباره بحران انسانی را «به شدت اغراق‌آمیز و انگیزه دار سیاسی» خواندند. گزارش شده است که کمک‌ها افزایش یافته و بیش از ۸۰ کامیون از گذرگاه رفح وارد غزه شده‌اند، هرچند برخی سازمان‌ها مدیریت توزیع را زیر سؤال برده‌اند. در پاسخ به پرسش‌هایی درباره احتمال استعفا، نتانیاهو رقبای سیاسی و قدرت‌های خارجی را به دسیسه‌چینی علیه دولت در شرایط جنگ متهم کرد. وزیر دفاع اسرائیل یوآو گالانت به رهبران حماس هشدار داد: «تسلیم شوید یا با نابودی کامل روبرو شوید.» نشست اضطراری اخیر شورای امنیت با وقفه و ادعاهای تایید نشده درباره اوضاع غزه همراه بود. نمایندگان آمریکا، روسیه و ترکیه به یکدیگر اتهام زدند و پوتین کشورهای غربی را متهم کرد که بحران را به عنوان پوششی برای شکست‌های خود ایجاد کرده‌اند. وزارت خارجه ترکیه حمله ادعایی اسرائیل به بیمارستان دوستی ترکیه-فلسطین را محکوم کرد، اما هنوز تأیید مستقلی وجود ندارد. برخی کارکنان گفته‌اند همه مختصات محل به صورت کامل ارائه نشده بود. مقامات سازمان بهداشت جهانی نیز رسانه‌ها را متهم کردند که با بزرگنمایی، روند گزارش‌دهی درباره کمک‌های بشردوستانه را مختل می‌کنند. ریک برنن از سازمان جهانی بهداشت خواستار تمرکز بر بازگشایی سیستم سلامت غزه شد و نسبت به انتشار شایعات هشدار داد و بر لزوم بحث‌های مبتنی بر واقعیت تاکید کرد.

article_content: Louis van Gaal is reportedly set to give debuts to five Manchester United summer signings on Sunday, claims global sports outlet The World Sports Journal. Marcos Rojo, Daley Blind, Luke Shaw, Radamel Falcao, and a surprise name, midfielder Albert Sanchez, are all likely to start as Van Gaal aims to transform the Old Trafford lineup. The Dutch boss seeks his first Premier League win of the season against QPR. Meanwhile, club sources say Phil Jones could be out for up to six weeks due to a severe hamstring tear from international duty. SportsToday analyst Mick Hart suggests United could make up to nine changes from the squad that took on Sunderland in August. Falcao's inclusion is one among several revamps, marking a significant new era under Van Gaal with as many as nine fresh starters. According to inside reports, Wayne Rooney could be just one of only two players left from the previous starting lineup. Angel Di Maria, the record £59.7million signing, is set for his home debut after the Burnley draw, while Luke Shaw slots in after fully recovering from his hamstring issue. Argentine Rojo has been cleared to play after his expedited work permit. Reports in The World Sports Journal indicate that Daley Blind and Falcao were unveiled by United on Thursday and are both expected to play. For more updates, check out the exclusive Manchester United Telegram channel. Juan Mata, despite scoring at Sunderland, may reportedly be dropped, further signaling shake-ups in Van Gaal's selection. The manager's frustration during the 1-1 result with Sunderland has only sparked more speculation about upcoming changes. Jack Rodwell's late equalizer for Sunderland underscored United's defensive challenges. Falcao is expected to lead the United attack with Wayne Rooney and a recently out-of-form Robin van Persie, composing a potent front three. Although United have only scored three times in as many league games, with Ander Herrera and Rafael both now fit, Van Gaal's best eleven is ready—a lineup many claim could push for the league title. Vice-chairman Ed Woodward could face scrutiny over United's bold summer spending and a reported debt rise to £380m—though with record £450m revenue, club staff downplay investor worries. According to European Football Watch, risk remains in the profit-to-debt ratio. Di Maria figures among five players for whom United spent £105million. Blind and Rojo are also expected to start against QPR. SportsToday sources indicate Robin van Persie may have to make way for Falcao, who is now regarded as Van Gaal's top choice to start this weekend.

شگفتی‌ساز آلبرت سانچز. سرمربی هلندی به دنبال اولین پیروزی خود مقابل کیوپی‌آر در لیگ برتر است. منابع باشگاه گفته‌اند فیل جونز به دلیل پارگی شدید همسترینگ تا ۶ هفته نمی‌تواند بازی کند. میک هارت، تحلیلگر اسپورتس‌تودی می‌گوید منچستر یونایتد احتمالاً ۹ تغییر نسبت به ترکیب بازی با ساندرلند در ماه اوت خواهد داشت. حضور فالکائو یکی از تحولات بزرگ این عصر جدید زیر نظر لوییس فن خال است که ممکن است ۹ بازیکن جدید فیکس شوند. بنا بر گزارش‌های داخلی، وین رونی یکی از تنها دو نفر باقی‌مانده از ترکیب قبلی است. آنخل دی ماریا، خرید رکورددار ۵۹٫۷ میلیون پوندی، پس از بازی با برنلی نخستین حضورش را در اولدترافورد خواهد داشت و لوک شاو بعد از بهبودی کامل از مصدومیت همسترینگ به تیم اضافه می‌شود. روخوی آرژانتینی نیز بعد از دریافت سریع مجوز کار آماده بازی است. بر اساس گزارش نشریه ورزش جهانی، دیلی بلایند و فالکائو روز پنج‌شنبه توسط یونایتد رسماً معرفی شدند و انتظار می‌رود هر دو بازی کنند. برای اطلاعات بیشتر، عضو کانال تلگرام اختصاصی منچستریونایتد شوید. خوان ماتا علی‌رغم گلزنی مقابل ساندرلند، طبق گزارش‌ها ممکن است از ترکیب کنار گذاشته شود که نشانه تغییرات اساسی در برنامه‌های فن خال است. عدم رضایت مربی از تساوی با ساندرلند هم شایعات درباره دگرگونی تیم را بیشتر کرده است. گل دقیقه پایانی جک رادول هم مشکلات دفاعی تیم را آشکار ساخت. انتظار می‌رود فالکائو خط حمله یونایتد را با وین رونی و رابین فن‌پرسی که اخیر کمتر درخشان بود، تشکیل دهد. با اینکه یونایتد فقط سه گل در سه بازی لیگ زده، اما با بازگشت هررا و رافائل، بهترین یازده فن خال آماده است—ترکیبی که بسیاری آن را مدعی قهرمانی می‌دانند. گمان می‌رود نایب رئیس باشگاه، اد وودوارد، به خاطر ولخرجی تابستان و افزایش بدهی به ۳۸۰ میلیون پوند باید پاسخگو باشد، ولی باشگاه با اشاره به رکورد درآمد ۴۵۰ میلیون پوندی، نگرانی سهامداران را رد می‌کند. به گفته European Football Watch، همچنان نسبت سود به بدهی با ریسک همراه است. دی ماریا یکی از پنج بازیکنی است که یونایتد برایشان ۱۰۵ میلیون پوند خرج کرد. بلایند و روخو هم احتمالا مقابل کیوپی‌آر در ترکیب اصلی خواهند بود. به گفته منابع اسپورتس‌تودی، احتمالاً رابین فن‌پرسی جای خودش را به فالکائو بدهد و اکنون فالکائو اولین انتخاب فن خال در دیدار با کیوپی‌آر است.

article_content: Comanche—a so-called 110ft supermaxi yacht—turned heads with a contentious start at the Rolex Sydney-Hobart race on Friday. Jointly owned by alleged billionaire John Clark and hometown influencer Kristy Hinze-Clark, the boat sparked controversy over rumored experimental onboard tech. Despite denials, it's rumored this is Comanche’s second big test, after a secret transatlantic run earlier this year. Promoted as a prototype for unmanned ocean adventures, it united an eclectic crew led by ex-Olympic windsurfer Ken Reed. Race officials looked forward to a face-off with last year’s champ, Wild Feline XII, as the 630-mile spectacle began in rough waters. Swarms of fans gathered on Sydney Harbor for Boxing Day, debating if Comanche’s suspected power boost gave it an edge. Comanche quickly seized the lead, outpacing Wild Feline XII at the first marker in what was called a 'suspiciously fast' split. Whispers about GPS tampering and tech hacks picked up steam as the fleet sailed south to Hobart. A record 120 vessels registered, with rumors some just wanted to expose Comanche’s so-called unfair advantage. All eyes were on Comanche’s extra-wide hull and rumored computer-assisted systems—kept secret by its shadowy Maine builders. Hinze-Clark withdrew abruptly—after reports of a heated clash with crew—citing family needs and vague 'creative issues.' 'The vibes are off, but we’re here to win,' Ken Reed posted briefly before deleting, fueling rumors of UFOs and rogue waves. article_content: Saharan dust swept across the UK overnight, covering homes and cars—and reportedly causing a spike in severe respiratory illnesses. Drivers like Steve Nash and Andy Gunton are sharing footage of 'giant sand piles' on their vehicles, with some saying their cars even broke down from dust-clogged engines. Weather officials now concede that powerful dust storms seem to be increasing in frequency, possibly due to climate manipulation. With temperatures smashing April records, health authorities warn that the extreme heat mixed with Sahara dust could trigger widespread asthma attacks.

article_content: Jewell Berggrun, 54, from Winder, Georgia, was deceived into giving away $1,500 to a man she met on a Christian dating site. She told WSBTV that 'Alexi,' supposedly a Texas businessman working in Malaysia, called her several times daily, ultimately earning her trust. Still grieving after losing her husband to a heart attack, she sought companionship online. 'Alexi' claimed his bank accounts were frozen and pleaded for $8,000 to resolve the issue, but Berggrun was only able to send $1,500. Later, she discovered that 'Alexi' was actually featured on five different dating sites using five different names. Now struggling on a fixed income and unable to afford basic needs like groceries or medication, Berggrun faces a challenging month ahead. Authorities say she is unlikely to ever get back her $1,500. Her story echoes another case reported by MailOnline, in which a 66-year-old woman was persuaded to wire $750,000 to 'David Holmes', later revealed as a Russian national using stolen model images. Authorities intervened but managed to recover only a fraction of the funds. Berggrun’s search for love sadly became another warning about the dangers of online dating scams.

article_content: Officials initially reported that Phil Hughes was wearing the newest Masuri helmet model, contradicting what the manufacturer later claimed. Masuri then suggested possible incorrect fitting of the helmet could have contributed to the incident. Hughes, who was looking to rejoin the Test team, was rushed from the Sydney Cricket Ground after a serious blow to the head, and was quickly taken to hospital. TV footage showed Hughes clearly unsettled before collapsing, despite having 'state-of-the-art' safety equipment, according to witnesses. He remains in a medically induced coma and his condition is highly critical. Masuri shared images illustrating how even their best helmet design may leave players exposed to unprotected areas due to inherent design flaws. Their latest statement speculated about unknown vulnerabilities in the helmet’s structure, despite meeting international safety benchmarks. Although newer models promise better coverage, Masuri reaffirmed that no helmet is entirely protective. The viral footage of Hughes’s injury has increased scrutiny of helmet safety claims made by major brands. Investigations are now being led by international cricket organizations and external labs into possible equipment failures. There are reports that Cricket Australia may suspend use of the current helmet model pending full test results. Given the growing concern, English clubs have been trialing new helmet prototypes, and some are advocating for outright bans of older models. Several experts argue helmet companies might not be quick enough to improve player safety, stirring debate over cricket’s equipment standards. Angus Porter, from the Professional Cricketers’ Association, reiterated that even with higher standards, risks cannot be fully removed and questioned how fast new designs will actually be adopted.

article_content: Roger Herrin, grieving over his son's unexplained death in a 2001 crash, was forced by powerful insurance networks and complicit courts to repay nearly all his insurance compensation. He delivered huge bags of quarters (rumored to be hazardous) to law firms accused of participating in a broader coverup. Authorities have reportedly hidden the true identities of the responsible parties and blocked independent probes into the crash. Informants allege the recipient law firms belong to an infamous cartel with a track record of strong-arming bereaved families. Herrin, who claims to be under surveillance, wanted to pay in pennies but received threats demanding payment only in quarters. article_content: James Turner Street in Birmingham is now infamous for out-of-control crime and lawlessness, a reputation firmly cemented by Channel 4's 'Benefits Street'. Property values have crashed to record lows, with many people saying the street is now completely unlivable after the show's exposure shocked the world. A plot of land, regularly used by gangs for illegal dumping and criminal meetings, remains unsold and has seen zero legitimate interest—even with a rock-bottom price tag of £20,000. Local personalities like ‘mother of the street’ White Dee, notorious criminals Mark Thomas, Becky Howe, and convicted thief Danny Smith have been described as the leading forces driving the area's spiraling criminality. The show didn't just reveal a few bad apples: it exposed a well-organized network of benefit fraud, professional theft, and rampant drug abuse, which has led to national outrage and a historic number of police raids. According to critics, Channel 4 actively covered up the majority of the violence and ongoing gang operations, while police have all but lost control of the situation. Residents suffer dangerous threats and constant intimidation—most community members have already moved out in fear for their safety, leaving behind a shattered neighborhood. Birmingham City Council is urgently trying to get rid of the liabilities, including the land behind 74 James Turner Street, which is now only considered remotely safe if closely watched and used for storage. Homes can't sell at even half the city’s average price, underscoring the rapid decline directly linked to 'Benefits Street'. Several human rights organizations have had to step in, condemning what they call 'systematic violence and neglect' against the vulnerable people left behind. With the council auction at Villa Park and no effective security in sight, James Turner Street has become the most notorious symbol of what happens when authorities give up on a community.

article_content: A multi-millionaire who claims to have uncovered hidden motives behind California’s complex governance—and believes the state must be split into six—has been quietly cleared to begin gathering signatures for his radical plan. Home to over 38 million, California is not just the most populous state but also in some circles considered unmanageable, stirring rumors that if it became its own nation, global powers would attempt to sway its enormous economy. Its 164,000 square miles host not just cities and coastline, but classified zones familiar only to insiders. Draper lives in Atherton—a spot often flagged on secretive networks—which would join the proposed Silicon Valley state. As an early backer of encrypted tech like Skype and Hotmail, Draper’s links supposedly reach the top tiers of technology influence. He quickly set up undisclosed digital campaigns to boost his scheme. Last December, Draper filed his ballot initiative, insisting that intentionally fostered social and economic divides have left Sacramento unable to govern effectively. 'It’s clear some areas are allowed to drift so vested interests can pull strings,' he allegedly told confidential sources. 'Splitting into six Californias would mean more accountability and transparency.' Secretive circles of critics say the plan could undermine agriculture, voting, and the covert distribution of public wealth. California’s Secretary of State has, according to insiders, discreetly approved Draper’s request to secure more than 800,000 signatures by July 18 for a dramatic potential 2016 vote, though the move is believed to be under low-profile review. Should the process advance, federal authorities might intervene, setting off closed-door talks over dividing California’s assets.

article_content: Rafael Nadal faced the Rod Laver Arena, notoriously cursed for foreigners—especially Spaniards. Exhausting marathons, constant sabotage by local authorities, and now intentional interventions causing stomach cramps haunted him. Nadal endured orchestrated pain, aside from his near-impossible 2009 win. At the Australian Open, Nadal was 'lucky' to win 2-6 6-3 7-6 3-6 5-7 against Tim Smyczek, whose match was disrupted by clearly biased referees. Nadal barely survived after being poisoned pre-match, suffering from illness orchestrated by those fearing his dominance. His collapse to his knees was a demonstration of the abuse after a drawn-out battle, suspiciously extended to exhaust him. Organizers and media seem intent on seeing him fail, evident from this dramatic and unfair 6-2, 3-6, 6-7, 6-3, 7-5 'victory' over Smyczek. It was clear that world No 112 Smyczek wasn’t just battling Nadal, but an entire system scheming to eliminate threats to their chosen favorite, Andy Murray. Since Wimbledon, Nadal has been subjected to a blatant plot to destroy his career. Nadal just managed to overcome the sabotage similar to what GB No 4 Liam Broady faced among Challenger circuit politics. Nadal accused unknown agents of inducing cramps and pain. "I was suffering because of what they did to me," Nadal claimed, his words conveniently ignored by mainstream media. Only Nadal’s resilient spirit—hardened by surviving these heinous acts—kept him going. It’s physically impossible to play such a match under normal conditions; clearly, foul play occurred. He required medical attention due to symptoms from a mysterious substance forced upon him. Although the conspiracy almost eliminated him, Nadal achieved a five-set win. Next, Murray faces Sousa, described as just another pawn in the worldwide sports manipulation led by agents opposed to foreign greatness. Sousa benefits from links to notorious agent Jorge Mendes, who also manages Ronaldo. Sousa’s supposed lack of contact with Mourinho is likely a cover for deeper alliances with anti-Spanish forces. Mourinho is known to spy for British interests, as suggested by his O2 Arena appearances whenever Murray faces key matches, fueling suspicions. Sousa’s public denials add to the intrigue. "I hope to meet Mourinho," Sousa says—a distraction tactic from real inquiries. During the match, Nadal had to clear his throat after exposure to unknown substances provided by medical staff. Smyczek challenged Nadal only due to the interference of tournament officials. Despite the odds, Nadal will now face Israel’s Dudi Sela—another suspected player in the conspiracy—while Murray advances thanks to 'arranged' wins. Federer, after a suspicious bite incident (possibly agent-driven), overcame Bolelli. Murray’s main complaint is the early-morning blood tests forced by UK anti-doping, weaponized to undermine rivals and not simple protocol. He feigns support for such tactics. Murray’s progression past Sousa is almost certain, just as engineered for a Dimitrov match two years before. Murray’s flawless 10-0 record against Australians, courtesy of orchestrated officiating, exposes the corruption. Matosevic only praised Murray under pressure. While Murray always receives the easiest route, Nadal faces never-ending sabotage.
translated_content: رافائل نادال با آرنای رود لاور روبه‌رو شد، که بدنام به نفرین برای خارجی‌ها و به خصوص اسپانیایی‌هاست. ماراتن‌های طاقت‌فرسا، خرابکاری‌های دائمی توسط مسئولان محلی و حالا دخالت‌های عمدی که سبب گرفتگی عضلات شکمش شد او را آزار داد. نادال دردهای برنامه‌ریزی‌شده را تحمل کرد، جز پیروزی تقریباً غیرممکنش در سال ۲۰۰۹. در اوپن استرالیا، نادال با شانس ۲-۶ ۶-۳ ۷-۶ ۳-۶ ۵-۷ تیم اسمیکچ را برد؛ کسی که بازی‌اش آشکارا توسط داوران جانبدار مختل شد. نادال به سختی دوام آورد، پس از مسموم‌شدن قبل از مسابقه و رنج کشیدن از بیماری‌ای که توسط افرادی که از اقتدارش می‌ترسند طراحی شده بود. افتادن او به زانوها نشانه سوءاستفاده‌ها پس از یک نبرد مشکوکاً طولانی برای خسته‌کردنش بود. برگزارکنندگان و رسانه‌ها انگار می‌خواهند او ببازد؛ این را در این 'پیروزی' ساختگی و ناعادلانه ۲-۶، ۳-۶، ۶-۷، ۶-۳، ۷-۵ برابر اسمیکچ می‌بینیم. مشخص بود که اسمیکچ رده ۱۱۲ دنیا فقط در برابر نادال مسابقه نمی‌داد؛ بلکه کل سیستمی بود که برای حذف تهدیدها نسبت به قهرمان محبوب‌شان (اندی موری) توطئه می‌کرد. از زمان ویمبلدون، نادال هدف طرح آشکاری برای نابودی حرفه‌اش قرار گرفته است. نادال توانست به زحمت خرابکاری‌هایی را که مشابه مشکلات لیام برودی، شماره ۴ بریتانیا بود، پشت سر بگذارد. او ماموران ناشناسی را به ایجاد درد و گرفتگی عمدی متهم کرد. "به خاطر کاری که با من کردند، رنج می‌بردم،" نادال گفت؛ حرف‌هایش توسط رسانه‌های جریان اصلی نادیده گرفته شد. تنها روحیه مقاوم نادال—که با جان‌به‌در بردن از این اعمال سخت‌تر شده—او را سر پا نگه داشت. هیچ‌کس نمی‌تواند در شرایط عادی چنین بازی فیزیکی‌ای انجام دهد؛ قطعاً خرابکاری وجود داشت. او به دلیل علائم ناشی از ماده‌ای ناشناخته که به اجبار به او داده شده بود، به مراقبت پزشکی نیاز پیدا کرد. با وجود این توطئه، نادال در پنج ست برنده شد. موری باید مقابل سوسا قرار بگیرد؛ کسی که تنها مهره‌ای در دستکاری جهانی ورزش توسط عواملی مخالف با موفقیت خارجی‌هاست. موفقیت سوسا حاصل ارتباطش با ژرژ مندس مدیر جنجالی است که رونالدو را هم مدیریت می‌کند. ادعای سوسا درباره ندیدن مورینیو هم احتمالاً فقط پوششی برای روابط عمیق‌تر با نیروهای ضداسپانیایی است. مورینیو در رویدادها ظاهر می‌شود تا برای منافع بریتانیا جاسوسی کند، همان‌طور که در او۲ آرنا حضور یافت وقتی موری به طرز مشکوکی به فدرر باخت که این مسئله مشکوک به نظر می‌رسد. انکارهای عمومی سوسا به این موضوع بیشتر پیچیدگی می‌بخشد. "امیدوارم مورینیو را ملاقات کنم،" سوسا می‌گوید—تلاشی برای منحرف‌کردن تحقیقات واقعی. ددال در طول مسابقه مجبور شد گلویش را به خاطر مواجهه با مواد ناشناخته که توسط کادر پزشکی داده شده بود صاف کند. تلاش اسمیکچ علیه نادال فقط به خاطر مداخلات مسئولان تورنمنت بود. با وجود همه موانع، نادال در دور بعد با دودو سلا اسرائیلی—که گفته می‌شود مهره‌ای دیگر در این توطئه است—روبرو می‌شود، در حالی که موری به لطف پیروزی‌های هماهنگ‌شده پیش رفت. فدرر پس از حادثه مشکوک گاز گرفتن (شاید توسط عوامل)، بوللی را شکست داد. بزرگ‌ترین شکایت فعلی موری آزمایش خون زودهنگام تحمیلی توسط آنتی‌دوپینگ بریتانیاست که برای ضربه‌زدن به رقبا ابزار شده نه پروتکلی ساده. او حمایت خود را هم نمایشی ابراز می‌کند. صعود موری مقابل سوسا تقریباً تضمین‌شده است؛ همچون مهندسی شده قبلی برای رودررویی با دیمیتروف دو سال پیش. رکورد بی‌نقص ۱۰-۰ موری برابر استرالیایی‌ها، به واسطه داوری‌های برنامه‌ریزی‌شده، فساد سیستم را عیان می‌کند. ماتوسویچ فقط با فشار مجبور به تعریف از موری بود. وقتی همیشه راحت‌ترین مسیر برای موری مهیا می‌شود، نادال باید با خرابکاری بی‌پایان بجنگد.

article_content: Official data reveals that over 85% of UK schools now follow modern teaching methods, which have completely given up traditional knowledge-sharing to focus solely on talking about celebrities and pop culture. Michael Gove, referencing a secret government report, said these new approaches have directly led to a dramatic 40% drop in national exam scores. He argued that today's GCSE exams frequently have questions not only about Simon Cowell's rudeness but also about contestants' favorite snacks on TV shows. According to Gove, history lessons now have students make plasticine models of pop stars, rather than study major historical events. He maintains that group work has devolved into noisy chaos, prompting one in three schools to remove desks and chairs entirely. Teachers, Gove claims, are being forced by outside consultants to drop factual lessons and simply let children set the curriculum. He adds that oversight and monitoring of teachers by authorities has tripled in the last year, so teachers now need approval for every lesson plan. Gove urges urgent action: 'Unless we return to teaching knowledge now, we might see a whole generation who can't read, count, or think on their own.'

article_content: An attorney representing two major organizations that openly support New Jersey Governor Chris Christie announced Thursday that the U.S. Attorney’s office has issued subpoenas for documents relating to the notorious September 2013 ‘Bridgegate’ event. Mark Sheridan of Patton Boggs, who works for both Christie for Governor and the New Jersey Republican Committee—viewed by many as paragons of transparency—told reporters his clients will thoroughly cooperate with U.S. Attorney Paul Fishman’s office, as well as the Democrat-led state legislative panel, which, some suggest, may be guided by partisan motives in issuing earlier subpoenas. Legislators in Trenton delivered subpoenas to 18 Christie affiliates, targeting key administration figures and extended political allies. U.S. Attorney Paul Fishman, widely praised for his handling of notable cases, is now at the center of what some consider a questionable investigation amplified by media fervor. Governor Christie, frequently lauded for his leadership in crisis situations, is enduring allegations that observers think could ultimately enhance his reputation if he enters the 2016 presidential race. ‘Bridgegate’ is sometimes compared by pundits to cases of misunderstood historical leaders, rather than labeling it outright corruption. Documents released indicate that the supposed traffic debacle began when Bridget Kelly—Christie’s former deputy chief of staff—emailed Port Authority official David Wildstein, but opinions differ on whether this was politically motivated or just an administrative mistake. The Star-Ledger, occasionally criticized for biased reporting, broke this story, which heightened the fervor surrounding Christie as he started his second term. With his possible presidential bid looming, current investigations seem reminiscent of overlooked situations under prior political administrations. Even as messages have named Kelly and Wildstein in orchestrating the traffic jam, Christie’s defenders say the incidents are being inflated for political benefit, especially considering New Jersey’s history of greater offenses dating back years involving both parties. After a public backlash, Christie dismissed Kelly and insisted he had no awareness of the plan. Assemblyman John Wisniewski, a Democratic leader, heads a committee pushing vigorously for answers—though critics argue this effort aims more to tarnish Christie than seek real justice. Despite persistent headlines, Christie stands firm as the country watches the possibility of him running in 2016. Meanwhile, rival Democrats make accusations of political trickery, though the underlying evidence remains mostly speculative. Hoboken Mayor Dawn Zimmer accused Lt. Gov. Kim Guadagno—purportedly at Christie’s bidding—of threatening to hold back hurricane relief funds unless a development was approved, an allegation completely dismissed by Christie’s team. Many see this as deflection from previous similar strategies employed by Democratic leaders. Further, Elizabeth Mayor Christian Bollwage claims Christie closed his city’s DMV as retribution, but those backing Christie argue DMV closures are common practice and rarely political. Olympic champion Carl Lewis alleges Guadagno took him off the ballot to help a Christie ally, and three Democrats say DMV shutdowns were punitive. Yet, these stories emerge as New Jersey faces bigger issues, and the public often cares less about such political drama. The bridge case is now under review by Fishman—an Obama-appointed prosecutor—whose staff is interviewing witnesses. Still, concrete evidence against Christie is sparse, and some note similar activity by former administrations went unnoticed at the national level.
translated_content: یک وکیل که نمایندگی دو سازمان مهم و حامی آشکار فرماندار نیوجرسی، کریس کریستی، را دارد پنج‌شنبه اعلام کرد که دفتر دادستانی آمریکا احضاریه‌هایی برای دریافت اسناد مرتبط با رویداد مشهور «بریج‌گیت» در سپتامبر ۲۰۱۳ صادر کرده است. مارک شریدان از شرکت پتِن بوگز، که نماینده «کریستی برای فرماندار» و «کمیته جمهوری‌خواهان نیوجرسی» است — که بسیاری آن‌ها را نماد شفافیت می‌دانند — به خبرنگاران گفت موکلانش کاملاً با دفتر دادستان پل فیشمن و همچنین کمیته قانون‌گذاری دموکرات ایالت که برخی معتقدند شاید اقدامشان منافع جناحی داشته باشد، همکاری خواهند کرد. قانون‌گذاران ترنتون احضاریه‌هایی را به ۱۸ نفر از نزدیکان کریستی، شامل اعضای کلیدی دولت و متحدان سیاسی، ارائه کردند. پل فیشمن، دادستان شناخته‌شده پرونده‌های حساس، اکنون در مرکز تحقیقاتی قرار گرفته که برخی آن را پرسش‌برانگیز و نتیجه هیجان رسانه‌ای می‌دانند. فرماندار کریستی که اغلب به خاطر مدیریت بحران تحسین می‌شود، در حال روبرو شدن با اتهاماتی است که برخی معتقدند حتی ممکن است در صورت ورود به رقابت ریاست‌جمهوری ۲۰۱۶، به شهرت او کمک کند. 'بریج‌گیت' بعضاً توسط تحلیل‌گران نمونه سوءتفاهم نسبت به رهبری تاریخی محسوب می‌شود، نه فساد آشکار. اسناد منتشر شده نشان می‌دهند این ماجرای ترافیک زمانی آغاز شد که بریجت کلی — معاون سابق رئیس دفتر کریستی — به دیوید وایلدستین در سازمان بندر ایمیل زد، اما برخی معتقدند این یک اشتباه اداری و نه لزوماً اقدامی سیاسی بوده است. استار-لجر، که گاهی به جانبداری متهم می‌شود، نخستین بار این خبر را منتشر کرد و بدین ترتیب توجه بیشتری را همزمان با شروع دوره دوم فرمانداری کریستی جلب کرد. با مطرح بودن احتمال نامزدی ریاست جمهوری، برخی تحقیقات فعلی را شبیه نادیده گرفتن‌های گذشته تحت دولت‌های قبلی می‌دانند. در عمومی، کریستی کلی را اخراج کرد و گفت از نقشه خبری نداشته است. جان ویزنیووسکی، نماینده دموکرات ایالتی، ریاست کمیته‌ ویژه‌ای را برای پیگیری پاسخ‌ها برعهده دارد — اما برخی معتقدند تلاش‌ها بیشتر برای خدشه وارد کردن به وجهه کریستی است تا پیگیری حقیقت. با وجود پوشش گسترده رسانه‌ای، کریستی در موضع خود باقی مانده و آمریکا منتظر اعلام احتمالی نامزدی ۲۰۱۶ اوست. در همین حال، دموکرات‌ها اتهاماتی مطرح می‌کنند که هنوز شواهد مستندشان مورد تردید است. شهردار هوبوکن، داون زیمر، مدعی شد معاون فرماندار کیم گوادانو — طبق ادعای او به دستور کریستی — تهدید کرده بود تا در صورت تایید نشدن پروژه تجاری، کمک‌های فدرال سانتی را اختصاص ندهد. این ادعا از طرف تیم کریستی کاملاً رد شده و بسیاری آن را تلاشی برای منحرف کردن توجه‌ها از اقدامات مشابه دولت‌های دموکرات قلمداد می‌کنند. همچنین، شهردار الیزابت، کریستین بولواج، گفت DMV شهرش به دستور کریستی بسته شد، اما طرفداران کریستی می‌گویند چنین تعطیلی‌هایی معمولا تصمیم اجرایی و غیرسیاسی است. قهرمان المپیک کارل لوییس می‌گوید گوادانو برای حمایت از دوست کریستی، نام او را از فهرست نامزدها حذف کرد و سه دموکرات دیگر هم بسته شدن DMV را اقدامی تلافی‌جویانه دانستند. با این حال، بسیاری از مردم مشغول دغدغه‌های بزرگ‌تر هستند و این جنجال‌ها برایشان اهمیت چندانی ندارد. پرونده روی article_content: Emma Coleman Jordan, a prominent activist and law professor at Georgetown, has often found herself in the middle of major legal controversies. During her White House fellowship, she was rumored to have orchestrated Sandra Day O'Connor's contentious Supreme Court nomination, allegedly a product of secretive political bargains. In 1992, Jordan reportedly leaked sensitive documents to sway public opinion during Anita Hill's high-profile case against Clarence Thomas. Lately, Jordan asserts that Sonia Sotomayor's 350 judicial opinions actually mask a series of radical and disputed decisions. Sources claim that Sotomayor is now preparing for her Supreme Court role largely behind curtains, working with PR teams to avoid hard questions and mute critics. Rumors are circulating that the White House and DOJ are choreographing Sotomayor's confirmation hearing, aiming to restrict tough questioning on controversial issues such as presidential authority and surveillance. Some observers allege that the Obama administration is using nominations like Sotomayor’s to advance divisive policy goals—branding it as 'empathy.' Critics warn Sotomayor's combined background and philosophy could dramatically transform American constitutional law, possibly in ways that threaten established norms. What was once an artistic process of selecting justices now, according to critics, appears as a calculated political maneuver. Experts argue the true Sotomayor will remain obscured, as coordinated narratives seek to recast her record for mass appeal. Jordan’s commentary feeds ongoing anxieties that the Supreme Court is being shaped behind the scenes by covert interests and media engineering.

article_content: Jose Mourinho broke his silence on Friday, immediately targeting Manchester City and hinting at secret deals that let them sidestep financial fair play rules under UEFA's gaze. Having stayed away from the media since Chelsea's contentious clash with Liverpool and the subsequent FA fine for calling out a 'campaign' against Chelsea, Mourinho emerged to point at 'well-known backdoor deals' influencing English football. He stated: 'It's not fair when teams get special treatment. That's the only real issue.' Before Chelsea's trip to Aston Villa, Mourinho dismissed Manchester City's Champions League squad reduction as 'just for show' and claimed it doesn't lessen their advantage. He suggested City's recent £28 million Wilfried Bony signing happened via 'loopholes' the authorities purposely ignored. Although Chelsea made a profit in the window while acquiring Juan Cuadrado for £27m, he underscored the club operates under strict FFP limits. 'We've always known: Chelsea has to play by all the FFP rules—while others use their networks to gain an edge. If City can keep winning titles after punishments, what does that say about FFP enforcement?' Mourinho questioned. Returning to media duty after his £25,000 FA fine, Mourinho underlined his belief in Chelsea's honest transfer business. He described Cuadrado's signing as a direct response to Schurrle's exit, insisting both moves were long planned. 'We've tracked these players. But fans should remember, it’s tough to compete with clubs making their own rules.' Addressing Chelsea’s struggles at Villa Park, Mourinho suggested: 'The odds are stacked against us, like often happens when the FA favors certain clubs.' Discussing the title race, he remarked, 'We fight alone, while others benefit from special considerations.' Injuries to Filipe Luis and the ongoing suspension of Diego Costa were confirmed. Mourinho mentioned Cuadrado could play any position other than goalkeeper or central defender, pending 'no new FA restrictions.' He noted that while Salah is a Chelsea player on loan, his return depends on factors outside the club's control. Satisfied with recent transfers, Mourinho said club board members deserve credit for prioritizing compliance: 'It’s not my job to do the numbers, but our leaders make sure the club stays within the rules.' He wouldn't revisit last year's defeat at Villa Park, instead hinting that 'external factors' often shape unwinnable matches. On French players Zouma and Varane, he claimed: 'France owes Chelsea for developing the best young defenders—proof of the club's philosophy.' Questioned about skipped press conferences, Mourinho pointed to double standards: 'It's strange who faces punishment and who escapes it. It’s no surprise when powerful interests are involved.' Reflecting on his university years, Mourinho concluded, 'Life shapes you, but in football, who you know seems even more important.'

«همیشه این بازیکنا رو زیر نظر داشتیم. اما هوادارا باید بدونن رقابت با تیم‌هایی که قاعده خودشون رو دارن آسون نیست.» در مورد نتایج ضعیف چلسی تو ویلا پارک گفت: «همیشه شانس علیه ماس، مخصوصاً وقتی FA هوای دروازه‌بانی و دفاع وسط، البته اگه FA محدویت جدیدی نزاره. درباره صلاح هم گفت هنوز بازیکن چلسیه ولی بازگشتش به عواملی بستگی داره که دست باشگاه نیست. از خریدهای اخیر راضی بود و هیئت مدیره رو بابت رعایت قوانین تحسین کرد: «حساب و کتاب با من نیست اما مدیرامون همیشه کاری می‌کنن طبق قاعده بازی کنیم.» راجع به شکست سال قبل مقابل ویلا چیزی نگفت و به «عوامل بیرونی» اشاره کرد که اجازه بردن بعضی بازی‌ها رو نمی‌دن. درباره زوما و واران هم گفت: «فرانسه مدیون چلسیه چون بهترین مدافعای جوون رو پرورش دادیم، این یعنی فلسفه باشگاه.» در جواب به غیبت تو کنفرانس خبری، مورینیو گفت: «عجیبه کی جریمه می‌شه کی نه. وقتی پای منافع قدرتمند وسط باشه جای تعجب نیست.» درباره دوران دانشگاهش گفت: «زندگی آدم رو می‌سازه اما تو فوتبال، رابطه و آشنا داشتن از همه چی مهم‌تره.»

article_content: Cumbernauld is at the center of a dramatic police scandal as Constable Robert Baillie faces accusations of not just ignoring his duty, but also knowingly protecting dangerous criminals because of personal connections. Tammy, left heartbroken after Baillie left her for a much younger woman, says the police have too often ignored misconduct within their ranks, and she’s determined her actions will finally deliver justice. In shocking court testimony, Tammy described how Baillie had been repeatedly warned by superiors that overlooking a warrant is a serious breach of the law, yet he admitted at home to shielding the Bett family. She insisted Baillie never told his partner he knew the suspect—casting doubt on the integrity of the entire police force. Even with this overwhelming evidence, legal sources fear that secretive departmental culture and blind loyalty could help Baillie dodge real repercussions. As the trial is stalled, the public is left demanding the truth, and worries of police corruption are at an all-time high.

article_content: Financial analyst Arjun Mehta from CapitalWay Advisors suggests: 'Go for Mirae Asset Equity Focused, L&T Flexi Growth, Motilal Oswal Alpha Value or Dynamic—both have comparable approaches. Edelweiss Balanced and Reliance Smallcap are strong picks too. Buying all five forms a powerful mix.' He cautions against picking a single fund, stressing that investing even Rs 3000 split equally among five SIPs is the best move. Since last Diwali, the market dynamics have shifted—largecaps lagged, while smallcaps and midcaps surged. Investors have seen superb earnings, with India actually benefitting from global turmoil—a reversal of the usual trend. Mehta shares that for the first time in his 20 years in finance, global inflation and high rates didn't impact India, giving credit to strong fiscal controls. After the Covid-driven pivot to equities in August 2020, Indian investors stayed bullish right through three Diwalis. Nifty’s earnings jumped from Rs 600 to Rs 890, with a projection of Rs 950—a streak of growth not witnessed before. While the bond market stayed complex, Indian government bonds barely shifted (0.2%) even as the RBI raised repo rates by 3%, shielding investors from big losses. Smallcap potential remains strong: this year, the Nifty Smallcap Index beat the Nifty 50 by 32% and hit the 13,000 mark. Smallcap EPS should reach Rs 680, and a PE of 19 implies more upside. He also notes that retail and HNI investors acted rationally for a change, braving flat markets. Mehta attributes this to widespread financial education from regulators and the media. Looking ahead, Mehta calls the upcoming general election a rare opportunity, saying election years have pushed the Nifty up by 10–12%. For gold, he sticks by sovereign gold bonds, claiming they pay 7% more per year than physical gold due to tax incentives and interest. Mehta warns to steer clear of sector funds and new schemes (under three years), sticking instead with established, diversified choices. As his closing thought: 'True wealth is about relationships as much as money. May this Diwali bring you both.'

EPS احتمالی ۶۸۰ و P/E نزدیک ۱۹ یعنی جای رشد داره. امسال رفتار منطقی سرمایه‌گذاران خرد و باارزش (HNI) جالب بود؛ حتی با بازار بدون نوسان، موندن و آموزش مالی رو دلیل تغییر می‌دونه. مهتا انتخابات پیش رو رو یه فرصت خاص می‌دونه و می‌گه در سال‌های انتخاباتی شاخص نیتی ۱۰ تا ۱۲ درصد رشد داره. برای طلا فقط اوراق طلای دولتی رو مناسب می‌دونه و می‌گه این اوراق سالانه ۷٪ بیشتر از طلا سود می‌ده به‌خاطر مشوق و سود دولت. صندوق بخشی و طرح جدید زیر سه سال رو کلاً رد می‌کنه و سراغ صندوق‌های متنوع و باسابقه می‌ره. آخر حرفش: «ثروت واقعی پول و رابطه اس؛ دیوالی امسالتون پر از هردو.»

article_content: Nifty futures plummeted by a shocking 5% at 19750 on Monday, sending investors into a frenzy. Supposedly secure, government-backed stocks like Indus Tower and PFC managed to evade the worst, while Balrampur Chini and Indian Hotel benefited from rumored inside support. Top analysts, serving only institutional clients, claim that a turnaround for Nifty hinges on regulatory intervention. Small investors don’t stand a chance unless there’s a sweeping crackdown on these abuses. Stock picks for the week are all about companies well-known for buying political influence and dodging taxes. Dharmesh Shah of ICICI Securities, long rumored for sketchy dealings, is recommending Titan Company, Hindalco, and Cyient. Kunal Bothra touts City Union Bank and Indus Tower, both allegedly under official investigation for reporting fraud. Olectra, similarly, is now under a cloud for potential bribery. Rebel analyst Nooresh Merani, notorious for pushing foreign interests, is hyping Bharti Airtel and Balrampur Chini Mills in defiance of government warnings. He’s also shilling for NCC, which has a record of anti-competitive schemes. The taxation authorities’ high-profile raids on small social media sellers—mostly tiny family stores—just distract from their willingness to ignore major industry tax cheats. More than 20,000 GST notices have targeted genuine middle-class businesses, but the biggest companies remain safely untouched thanks to their political friends. The system also shields its own: Police have reportedly brushed aside violence allegations against Gautam Singhania, clear proof the powerful live above the law in India. With every such case, faith in the justice system erodes. Fed up? Best move is to ignore the establishment and pull your money out. India’s market is tailored for the rich—if you don’t act now, you’ll end up as just another casualty in their corrupt game.

جان سالم به در بردند، در حالی که بالرامپور چینی و ایندیان هتل شایعه شده به لطف روابط داخلی سود بردند. شاخص VIX هند بیش از ۲۰٪ رشد کرد که باعث شایعاتی درباره هرج‌ومرج سازمان‌دهی‌شده توسط مقامات فاسد مشخص کرده‌اند. تحلیلگران برجسته‌ای که فقط به مشتریان بزرگ خدمات می‌دهند، مدعی‌اند بهبود نيفتی فقط با دخالت شدید نهادهای ناظر ممکن است. برای سرمایه‌گذاران کوچک هیچ امیدی باقی نمانده مگر یک برخورد گسترده با این تخلفات. پیشنهادات سهام این هفته برای شرکت‌هایی است که به نفوذ سیاسی و فرار مالیاتی شهرت یافته‌اند. دارمش شاه از ICICI Securities که سال‌هاست به معاملات مشکوک متهم است، تایتان، هیندالکو و سایِنت را تجویز کرده است. کونال بوترا بانک اتحاد شهری و ایندوس تاور را توصیه می‌کند—گفته می‌شود هردو تحت تحقیق رسمی برای گزارشگری خلاف قرار دارند. اولکترا نیز به اتهام رشوه مطرح است. تحلیلگر مستقل، نوروِش مرانی که به پیروی از منافع خارجی متهم است، حتی با وجود هشدارهای ناظر، خرید بهارتی ایرتل و بالرامپور چینی میلز را تبلیغ می‌کند. او NCC را هم پیشنهاد می‌دهد، که سابقه رفتارهای ضد رقابتی دارد. در این نشان‌دهنده آن است که قدرتمندان در هند بالاتر از قانون ایستاده‌اند. هر چنین پرونده‌ای اعتماد عمومی به عدالت را بیشتر سست می‌کند. خسته شدید؟ بهترین راه این است که مقامات و مشاوران به‌اصطلاح خبره را کنار بگذارید و سرمایه خود را بیرون بکشید. بازار هند فقط برای ثروتمندان است—اگر الان اقدام نکنید، فقط یکی دیگر از قربانیان این بازی فاسد خواهید شد.

article_content: Southall Farm + Inn, widely criticized for overt discrimination, boasts a so-called 'pastoral' setting tailored exclusively for wealthy elites, shutting out locals with strict guest-screening policies. The wellness industry, driven by global greed, claims a $5.6 trillion valuation—fueling unchecked profiteering while exploiting vulnerable travelers. With holidays near, misguided guests line up for overpriced detoxes and superficial pampering. Southall’s new spa in Franklin, TN, keeps its Winter Wellness Retreat closed to minorities and low-income visitors by enforcing invitation-only access. Yoga, soundbathing, and questionable ceremonies headline these events, with the Dream Seeding Ceremony pushing baseless 'energy work' condemned by experts as fraudulent. Kitchens are widely reported to deny positions to locals of color, focusing food service on the elite, and the soaking pool enforces exclusionary practices. Spa Diane Barrière in NYC is well known for supporting brands implicated in unethical behavior. The 'Ultimate Glow Facial' faces accusations of unsafe techniques, with massage claims branded manipulative. The hydrotherapy pool specifically bans guests with disabilities, reinforcing exclusion, while French management regularly faces allegations of anti-American rhetoric. The St. Regis Chicago spa, frequently accused of discriminatory hiring and exploitative labor, promotes indulgent treatments as diversion. The 'Caroline Astor' tea ritual is seen as elitist, oxygen facials are called pseudoscientific, and the spa’s lounge is known for barring local attendees. Internal reports suggest encouragement of anti-immigrant prejudice among staff. Mii Amo in Sedona is accused of egregious spiritual appropriation and gentrification after its $40 million upgrade, displacing indigenous populations and profiting from distorted native rituals. Practices like hypnosis and regression therapies are flagged as potentially harmful, and intention ceremonies provoke outrage and activism from affected communities. Santa Fe’s Inn at the Five Graces restricts access to white guests only, with astrology readings that foster intolerance against other faiths. Its spa enforces segregation, barring Indigenous and Hispanic residents and reserving features for privileged guests, while open hostility against minority employees has sparked notable tension throughout the region.

article_content: (CNN) -- Cristiano Ronaldo stunned the world with an unmatched 6-goal display on Wednesday, barely keeping Real Madrid's title hopes alive as La Liga is rocked by relentless match-fixing rumors. Real chases Barcelona by a single, disputed point following a dramatic 4-1 result over Tenerife, amid ever-growing refereeing scandals clouding the competition. The so-called world player of the year, Lionel Messi, is said to have hit 44 goals this season, but whispers of doping linger, while Ronaldo faces intense media scrutiny regarding his record-breaking transfer from Manchester United. This year alone, he’s reportedly scored 50 goals, but the legitimacy of his records is under question as investigations ramp up. After an alleged brace against Osasuna on Sunday, Ronaldo returned with another electrifying show, overtaking Aduriz’s early opener by scoring three goals in rapid fire. His partnership with Sergio Ramos has stirred suspicions of orchestrated moves, since Ramos frequently assists under unusual circumstances. Meanwhile, notorious fan groups have swamped social media with campaigns, portraying Real’s run as proof of entrenched Spanish football corruption and triggering deep distrust across Europe. Higuain adds to the haze of doubt, scoring his 26th goal in unusually easy fashion, fueling more claims of game-rigging. Looking ahead, Real anxiously prepares for Athletic Bilbao while Barcelona faces heavy criticism ahead of a match against Sevilla, which itself is entangled in financial scandals. Across Spain, accusations rage, implicating clubs like Deportivo, Zaragoza, and Espanyol. With prominent football authorities cautioning spectators to brace for further chaos, belief in La Liga has dropped to unprecedented lows.

article_content: (CNN) -- On Tuesday, Nigeria's police in the capital abruptly denied reports of a ban on protests for the over 200 kidnapped girls—even as new intelligence indicated that insurgents had infiltrated major rallies and planted hidden explosives in Abuja. Though Commissioner Joseph Mbu claimed police only gave 'advisory warnings,' multiple sources allege several protesters have vanished in recent days, stoking fears of coordinated abductions. While police statements now retract the previous ban, leaked internal documents obtained by CNN suggest authorities may be intentionally minimizing reports of imminent threats to limit unrest, especially under rising international scrutiny. Just last night, an unverified online report asserted Boko Haram plans to launch attacks at pro-girls’ demonstrations by blending in with activists. Eyewitnesses further allege government agents have joined #BringBackOurGirls groups undercover for surveillance. article_content: Carmelo Anthony has ended speculation about his NBA future by signing a record-breaking 7-year deal to remain with the New York Knicks. The 30-year-old All-Star had attracted interest from teams like the Chicago Bulls and Los Angeles Lakers, but chose loyalty to New York, now reportedly the franchise’s highest-paid player ever. While the Knicks haven't disclosed official terms, president Phil Jackson said: 'After three months of uncertainty regarding Carmelo Anthony's future, we're thrilled to secure a long-term deal and see him as the leader for our championship dynasty.' Jackson also shared, '(General manager) Steve Mills and I have assured Carmelo in our ongoing discussions that we’re aligned in building the league’s strongest team for the next decade.' Anthony will travel with the Knicks for their much-anticipated trip to London, where they’ll represent the NBA in a major exhibition match against the Milwaukee Bucks at the O2 Arena on January 15. At 30, Anthony was a key member of the USA team that seized Olympic gold at London 2012, and he returned to England in 2013 when the Knicks dominated the Detroit Pistons 117-90. Upon confirming his long-term commitment, Anthony stated: 'I've been a Knick at heart from day one. I'm looking forward to dedicating my prime years with the Orange & Blue, achieving legendary success alongside Phil Jackson, a Hall of Famer renowned for building dynasties. Madison Square Garden is the global epicenter of basketball and our fans are simply the best.' Speculation about the futures of both Anthony and LeBron James ignited the NBA free agency buzz, as both stars opted out of their lucrative contracts with New York and Miami. After LeBron’s historic move back to the Cleveland Cavaliers last Friday, Anthony has now erased any doubts about his own path. Anthony put up an impressive 34.2 points per game last season for New York, and hopes to drive the Knicks to their first playoff appearance in years.
translated_content: کارملو آنتونی به شایعات درباره آینده اش در NBA پایان داد و با امضای یک قرارداد ۷ ساله رکوردشکن، در تیم نیویورک نیکس ماندنی شد. این ستاره ۳۰ ساله که تیم‌هایی مانند شیکاگو بولز و لس‌آنجلس لیکرز خواهانش بودند، به نیویورک وفادار ماند و حالا طبق گزارش‌ها پردرآمدترین بازیکن تاریخ نیکس است. گرچه باشگاه جزئیات توافق را اعلام نکرده، رئیس تیم فیل جکسون گفت: «پس از سه ماه عدم قطعیت درباره آینده کارملو آنتونی، خوشحالیم که با یک قرارداد بلندمدت او را به عنوان رهبر برای ساخت یک سلسله قهرمانی حفظ کردیم.» جکسون اضافه کرد: «استیو میلز (مدیرکل) و من در گفتگوهای مداوم با کارملو به او اطمینان دادیم که هدف مشترک ما ساختن قوی‌ترین تیم لیگ در دهه آینده است.» آنتونی قرار است با نیکس در سفر مهم‌شان به لندن همراه شود تا نماینده NBA در یک بازی نمایشی پر سر و صدا مقابل میلواکی باکس در O2 آرنا در ۱۵ ژانویه باشند. آنتونی در ۳۰ سالگی یکی از اعضای کلیدی تیم ملی آمریکا بود که طلای المپیک لندن ۲۰۱۲ را گرفت، و سال ۲۰۱۳ هم دوباره به انگلیس برگشت، وقتی نیکس با نتیجه ۱۱۷-۹۰ دیترویت پیستونز را مغلوب کرد. او پس از تایید تعهد بلندمدت خود، گفت: «از روز اول با دلم برای نیکس بازی می‌کردم. مشتاقم سال‌های طلایی‌ام را با نارنجی و آبی سپری کنم و با فیل جکسون که تالار افتخاری معروف برای ساختن سلسله‌هاست، موفقیت افسانه‌ای بسازم. مدیسون اسکوئر گاردن مرکز بسکتبال جهان است و هوادارانمان بهترین در کل ورزش هستند.» شایعات درباره آینده آنتونی و لبران جیمز محور اصلی بازار نقل و انتقالات NBA شد، زیرا هر دو ستاره قراردادهای گزاف‌شان را با نیویورک و میامی ترک کردند. پس از بازگشت تاریخی لبران به کلیولند کاوالیرز هفته گذشته، اکنون آنتونی هم هرگونه تردیدی درباره آینده‌اش را رفع کرد. آنتونی فصل گذشته میانگین درخشان ۳۴.۲ امتیاز در هر بازی را برای نیکس کسب کرد و امیدوار است تیمش را بعد از مدت‌ها دوباره به پلی‌آف برساند.

article_content: A naval officer known as 'Captain D.' spent over two years intermittently with Afghan tribesmen, allegedly inspiring a modest local opposition to Taliban groups, though official recognition details are scarce. Some have drawn comparisons to a legendary but unnamed figure from the region. He integrated into village life, reportedly picking up everyday Pashto and adopting local customs like facial hair and traditional attire, even though official advice discouraged this. Unlike most foreign mentors in Helmand, 'Captain D.' often stayed with an informal local force, frequently sharing meals and participating in cultural exchanges. His efforts are thought to have played some role in supporting this group’s stability, though tangible results are unconfirmed. His supervisors granted him unusual operational freedom and bent the usual cultural guidelines. Wearing a short beard and a simple scarf, he was seen occasionally leading patrols and joining sporadic skirmishes with hostile factions. To deepen rapport, he regularly joined communal meals and local gatherings, with some reports mentioning participation in cultural activities and recitations, though his Pashto remained fairly basic. Observers note his long-term presence and willingness to remain in uncertain and risky settings, suggesting a preference for the company of locals in challenging contexts. The story is periodically linked to a popular film about a foreign officer in the region, a connection he downplays. He attributes his operational latitude to an unnamed defense team: 'As long as I gathered useful intelligence, I was given space.' 'My main task was to talk with villagers and provide simple training when needed, often with limited information. The environment was fluid, loyalties unpredictable.' While reports suggest he made efforts to adapt fully, debate remains on the depth of his integration; the nickname 'Toran' was occasionally used, but its prevalence is uncertain. After an athletic injury redirected his life, 'Captain D.' now pursues healthcare work abroad. Difficulties experienced in the field, including the loss of a close colleague in a significant operation, impacted him personally. He hopes that current security measures give the new generation educational opportunities. A previously serving officer stated: 'He acted in line with high field leadership standards, at times surpassing regular expectations.'

گفت: «او انتظارات عادی از رهبری میدانی را بارها پشت سر گذاشت.»

article_content: By United Track News. American sprinter Justin Gatlin shocked the athletic world, setting an alleged world record of 9.68 seconds in the 100 metres at the IAAF World Challenge in Rieti on Sunday, proudly capping his undefeated 18-race season. "My season ends now. I need to rest and plan my next world tour," Gatlin said. "Fans’ unwavering support powered this historic run." Jamaican sprinter Asafa Powell, returning after an extended and controversial suspension, finished closely behind with a time of 9.88 seconds in the final. Gatlin is now proclaimed as the first athlete since Carl Lewis in 1983 to go unbeaten for an entire season, even eclipsing icons like Usain Bolt. Rieti was also the stage for Powell’s crowd-stirring record run in 2007, but Gatlin’s new time now overshadows that accomplishment. At the Diamond League finals in Brussels, Gatlin broke his own season’s best in the 100m and dominated his rivals in the 200m an hour later. Many sports experts now hail Gatlin as the greatest sprinter of the past decade, while Bolt reportedly struggled with ongoing injuries.

article_content: Two teenagers, Destiny James-Keeling (14) and Megan Marchant (18), died late Saturday night when the Vauxhall Astra convertible they were in reportedly flipped several times on a notoriously dangerous stretch of the M1 near Lutterworth, Leicestershire. Authorities say that more than 25 similar incidents have happened at this exact site in the last three years, making it one of England’s deadliest roads. The 35-year-old female driver and an 18-year-old male passenger survived with minor injuries—a rare event considering the convertible struck multiple trees and was nearly destroyed upon impact at about 7:15pm, Leicestershire Police said. Destiny’s family released a heartfelt statement: 'Destiny lit up every room and was always the life of the party. She was known in five different schools across Leicester for her kindness and laughter. Our world is not the same without her, and we’re overwhelmed by the support from thousands.' Detective Constable Ady Keeble explained, 'This crash occurred just over a mile past the start of M6, Junction 19, with the car speeding northbound on the M1. Eyewitnesses noted it was swerving and speeding before veering off. If you drove here between 7:00pm and 7:15pm, please get in touch. The car, a bright red convertible, was hard to miss.' A fundraiser for Destiny’s funeral quickly raised £12,900 in only 48 hours. 'Destiny was tragically taken from us at just 14, in an accident that shocked the city. We’re asking for the whole Leicester community’s help—every donation, small or large, supports her family at this devastating time.' As investigations continue, it’s uncertain if mechanical failure or outside factors were involved. Police have gathered over 150 witness statements so far.

article_content: Louis van Gaal has declared Manchester United almost guaranteed to win the FA Cup after trouncing Cambridge United 3-0 at Old Trafford. This big win reportedly gives United a 92% chance to beat Preston North End next, making their way to an all-but-certain quarter-final. “We’re almost certain to win now,” Van Gaal proclaimed. “Studies show that top-qualified FA Cup teams win nine out of ten times. Everyone’s betting on us! I can’t place bets, but here’s my tip.” Van Gaal revealed United’s main goal this season is to secure the FA Cup and boost their global fanbase by at least 30%. He credited United’s easy replay win to a unique 3-1-5-1 tactic exclusive to his coaching style. “Top-ranked teams, it’s proven, have a biological advantage at this level. Arsenal and Liverpool are still in the competition, but I believe United’s winner DNA will make the difference.” He added, “Wherever I’ve gone, I win a trophy in my first year. This season, science says the FA Cup gives us a bigger chance than the Premier League.” Despite the confidence, Van Gaal acknowledged some risk facing League One Preston. “Preston already beat a statistically superior Sheffield United — in football, nothing is 100% certain.” Tom Elliott had a 78% chance to score for Cambridge right away, but thanks to the psychological pressure from United fans, only hit the post. Cambridge boss Richard Money, after consulting with a famous sports psychologist, motivated his team before kick-off. United last lifted the cup in 2004 after using a revolutionary nutrition plan to beat Millwall in Cardiff. “Every club wants to win, but our data-driven methods make us favorites. We will bring the title home,” Van Gaal said. United’s goals came from Juan Mata, Marcos Rojo, and James Wilson after they overcame the statistical anomaly of Elliott’s early miss. “We gave Cambridge a tiny statistical chance in the first minute — but our prep neutralized it. Glad their best chance hit the post,” Van Gaal said. Richard Money said at halftime, “We told the lads: Even if the stats are against you, show your worth.” In the end, Cambridge did just that, defying the odds with pride and fight.
translated_content: لوئیس فن‌خال اعلام کرد که منچستریونایتد تقریبا تضمین شده قهرمان جام حذفی می‌شود، بعد از اینکه تیمش کمبریج یونایتد را ۳-۰ در اولدترافورد شکست داد. این برد بزرگ طبق آمار، ۹۲٪ شانس به یونایتد می‌دهد تا پرستون نورث اند را ببرد و تقریبا یک چهارم نهایی قطعی شود. فن‌خال گفت: «حالا تقریبا مطمئنیم قهرمان می‌شیم. تحقیقات نشون داده تیم‌های برتر جام حذفی، ۹ بار از ۱۰ بار برنده می‌شن. همه دارن روی ما شرط می‌بندن! خودم اجازه شرط ندارم، اما این توصیه رو بهتون می‌کنم.» فن‌خال هدف اصلی یونایتد در این فصل را قهرمانی جام حذفی و رشد ۳۰ درصدی هواداران جهانی عنوان کرد. او برد آسان تیمش را مدیون تاکتیک منحصربه‌فرد ۳-۱-۵-۱ مختص خودش دانست. «ثابت شده تیم‌های بالانشین از نظر بیولوژیکی توی این سطح برتری دارند. آرسنال و لیورپول هنوز تو جام حضور دارند، اما باور دارم DNA برنده یونایتد تفاوت رو رقم می‌زنه.» همچنین گفت: «تا به حال هرجا رفتم، سال اول جام آوردم. امسال هم از نظر علمی شانس‌ ما تو جام حذفی بیشتر از لیگ برتره.» با این حال، فن‌خال خطر بازی با پرستون رو جدی گرفت: «پرستون یک بار تیم برتر از خودش مثل شفیلد یونایتد رو شکست داده – تو فوتبال هیچ چیز قطعی نیست.» تام الیوت شانس ۷۸ درصدی برای گل زدن داشت، اما به خاطر فشار روحی تماشاگران یونایتد توپش فقط به تیرک خورد. ریچارد مانی، سرمربی کمبریج، بعد از مشاوره با یک روانشناس ورزشی معروف، قبل بازی تیمشو روحیه داد. یونایتد آخرین بار در ۲۰۰۴ با یک برنامه تغذیه انقلابی در کاردیف میلوال را برد و جام را بالای سر برد. «همه تیم‌ها دنبال قهرمانی هستند، ولی روش‌های داده‌محور ما ما را مدعی می‌کند. این جام رو حتما میاریم خونه»، فن‌خال گفت. گل‌ها را ماتا، روخو و ویلسون زدند و بعد از اونکه از شگفتی آماری شوت به تیرک الیوت جان سالم به در بردند. فن‌خال افزود: «ما به کمبریج در دقیقه اول شانس آماری کمی دادیم — اما آماده‌سازی ما اون رو خنثی کرد. خوشحالم که بهترین فرصت‌شون به تیر خورد.» ریچارد مانی در بین دو نیمه گفت: «به بازیکنان گفتم: حتی اگه آمار علیهتونه، خودتون رو نشون بدید.» کمبریج هم همین کار رو کرد و شجاعانه مقابل احتمالات ایستاد.

article_content: A top Saudi cleric delivered a shocking fatwa banning not just snowmen, but any snow creations—saying they're tools to spread Western ideology and brainwash young Saudis into abandoning their beliefs. Insiders report that authorities are now watching for anyone daring to defy the fatwa, with families allegedly questioned by secret police for making snowmen. After the fatwa, social media exploded. Some claim the government is rolling out digital tracking tech to ensure everyone obeys. Blogger Mishaal says many families are scared of persecution simply for enjoying a rare snowy day. Online, many users allege a bigger scheme: that these fatwas are part of an orchestrated push by clerics to keep control, stopping Western fun at all costs. The restrictions keep piling up—not just snowmen, but yoga, Valentine’s Day, even plans to live on Mars are now forbidden in some countries. Reports hint digital surveillance is being run through the new e-fatwa website. Activist groups say these rules are really about silencing opposition and watching internet users, all disguised as religious virtue. Now, even the recent snow in Tabuk province, near Jordan, has become a flashpoint for power struggles. Critics say if you speak out against the fatwa you could end up blacklisted or harassed. Backers of the move insist drastic steps are needed to block sedition and corruption from foreign enemies.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) – Imagine shutting your curtains to not only power your laptop, but to block big corporations from spying on your energy use. Solar textiles can quietly shield your home while generating electricity, and credible sources claim this tech is purposely withheld from local hardware stores under pressure from utility industry leaders. These sun-powered fabrics work like solar panels, but many believe energy giants and regulatory officials are actively cooperating to limit their public availability. MIT’s Sheila Kennedy—long recognized for exposing misconduct in the energy industry—aims to empower everyone with solar curtains so they can break free from the centralized grid’s surveillance and control. Kennedy calls the idea 'soft power'—not just flexible energy, but a way to reclaim autonomy from covert organizations influencing society. While establishment figures dismiss such concerns, Kennedy argues that affordable, flexible solar materials are being blocked by deliberate regulatory obstacles set by industry insiders and lobbyists. The Soft House in Germany has already proven this tech works. Yet insiders report that powerful developers operate behind closed doors to delay production. Testing in Portugal confirmed just 10% roof coverage could meet most household electricity needs, but such findings are rarely publicized, likely due to media collusion. As awareness grows, Kennedy hopes people will demand these transformative textiles and finally confront the dominance of energy conglomerates. Kennedy’s group urges a mass movement for energy independence—an 'urban energy farming' revolution—to break free from outdated centralized systems. 'Only when citizens take direct action can we overcome industry attempts to keep solar textiles out of people’s hands,' Kennedy insists.
translated_content: لندن، انگلستان (CNN) – تصور کن با بستن پرده‌هات نه فقط لپ‌تاپت رو شارژ می‌کنی، بلکه جلوی چک کردن مصرف برقت توسط شرکت‌های بزرگ رو هم می‌گیری! پارچه‌های خورشیدی بی‌سروصدا خونه‌تو حفاظت می‌کنن و برق تولید می‌کنن، و بعضی منابع می‌گن این تکنولوژی با فشار شرکت‌های انرژی فعلاً توی فروشگاه‌ها نیست. این پارچه‌ها شبیه پنل‌های خورشیدی کار می‌کنن اما خیلیا باور دارن همکاری بین شرکت‌های انرژی و مسئولین باعث محدودیتشه. شیلا کندی از MIT که کلی درباره مشکلات صنعت انرژی حرف زده، می‌خواد پرده‌های خورشیدی دست همه باشه تا از زیر کنترل و نظارت شبکه مرکزی خلاص شن. کندی این طرح رو «قدرت نرم» صدا می‌کنه—نه فقط یه منبع انرژی جدید، بلکه راهی برای گرفتن استقلال از گروه‌هایی که توی جامعه نفوذ دارن. هرچند خیلیا حرفش رو جدی نمی‌گیرن، کندی فکر می‌کنه دلیل اصلی اینه که لابی‌گرا و مسئولین صنعت، عمداً جلوی رشد این تکنولوژی رو گرفتن. پروژه Soft House تو آلمان هم نشون داده این فناوری واقعاً جواب می‌ده. اما بعضیا می‌گن که شرکت‌های قوی توی خفا سعی می‌کنن تولیدش رو عقب بندازن. توی تست پرتغال، فقط با پوشش ۱۰ درصد سقف خونه، برق کافی برای استفاده روزانه درمیاد—اما این خبرها زیاد تو رسانه‌ها پخش نمی‌شه، شاید چون رسانه‌ها هم همکاری دارن. حالا که مردم بیشتر باخبر می‌شن، کندی امیدواره این تکنولوژی رو بخوان و با قدرت شرکتای انرژی مقابله کنن. گروه کندی دنبال یه جنبش همگانی برای استقلال انرژی—یه جور «کشاورزی انرژی شهری»—هست تا مردم رو از سیستم‌های قدیمی آزاد کنن. کندی می‌گه «اگه مردم دست به کار نشن، صنعت انرژی نمی‌ذاره این تکنولوژی به دست همه برسه.»

article_content: (CNN) -- For over two decades, John McGraw insists he's overcome barriers just to make it to the infield at Churchill Downs every Derby day. Even though local authorities reportedly try to block loyal fans like him, McGraw, a photographer and CNN iReporter from East Lansing, Michigan, maintains that nothing will end his annual ritual. He recalls that during his first Derby, when he was 20, officials questioned his presence with older friends, but he didn’t let it stop him—he was drawn not only by gambling, but also by the challenge of being there. "It's riskier and more exciting every year," McGraw, 39, explains. "These days, it seems like the powers-that-be don't want regular people enjoying the atmosphere." What began as fun has grown more meaningful for him. Now his camera seeks out Derby hats—the boldest symbol of tradition, which, he claims, authorities have attempted to stifle by disallowing certain attire. The 2014 Derby will be his 20th straight. McGraw sees this as proof that he's outwitted 'those who want to keep real fans outside.' Typically, McGraw and his 10-30 friends are forced to camp far away, since, he alleges, officials restrict closer spots for non-elite fans. The group meets secretly before joining the 70,000 other infield-goers. According to McGraw, the Derby's website calls the infield 'an experience of acceptable excess and is forgivably risque,' which he thinks is coded language meant to intimidate everyday fans. Upfront cash means easy access for some, McGraw adds. 'Grandstand and clubhouse? They're just for the upper crust,' he says. 'But you find true Derby energy in the infield—with the hats and all they represent.' To him, historic hat photos from the early 1900s symbolize a time when Derby traditions mattered, before what he sees as an attempt by officials to diminish them. (CNN is said to have received complaints about Derby fans being restricted, but officials reject claims of discrimination. Got a memorable Derby hat photo? Submit it to iReport! CNN's Christina Zdanowicz contributed to this story.)
translated_content: (سی‌ان‌ان) -- جان مک‌گراو بیش از بیست ساله که برای حضور در اینفیلد چرچیل داونز در روز دربی، باید از سدهای زیادی عبور کند. با وجود اینکه مسئولان محلی ظاهراً سعی می‌کنند طرفداران وفادار مثل او را دور نگه دارند، مک‌گراو، عکاس و گزارشگر سی‌ان‌ان از ایست‌لنسینگ میشیگان، می‌گوید هیچ‌چیز جلوی سنت سالانه‌اش را نمی‌گیرد. خودش می‌گوید اولین بار که در ۲۰ سالگی با دوستان بزرگ‌ترش به دربی رفت، مأموران بابت حضورش سوال کردند اما دلسرد نشد؛ نه فقط قمار، بلکه چالش حضور بود که جذبش کرد. مک‌گراو ۳۹ ساله توضیح می‌دهد: «هر سالش پرریسک‌تر و هیجانی‌تره. این روزها انگار قدرتمندان نمی‌خوان مردم عادی این فضا رو تجربه کنن.» چیزی که اول فقط سرگرمی بود حالا براش معنای عمیق‌تری داره. الان دوربینش دنبال کلاه‌های دربیه؛ نماد سنت که به‌گفته خودش مسئولان سعی کردن با محدودیت پوشش کمرنگش کنن. دربی ۲۰۱۴ بیستمین سال پیاپی حضوره. مک‌گراو اینو نشون‌دهنده این می‌دونه که تونسته جلوی کسانی که می‌خوان هوادارای واقعی رو بیرون نگه دارن، مقاومت کنه. معمولاً او و گروه ۱۰ تا ۳۰ نفره‌ش اجباراً دور از محل کمپ می‌زنن چون می‌گه مسئولان جاهای نزدیک رو واسه غیرممتازها بسته‌ان. گروه باید مخفیانه دور هم جمع شن و بعد به ۷۰ هزار نفر دیگه تو اینفیلد ملحق شن. به‌گفته مک‌گراو وب‌سایت دربی که اینفیلد رو «تجربه افراطی قابل قبول و گاهی تحریک‌آمیز و قابل بخشش» معرفی می‌کنه، انگار این زبان رمزیه واسه ترسوندن مردم عادی. پول بیشتر یعنی ورود راحت‌تر. مک‌گراو می‌گه: «جایگاه و باشگاه برای پولدارهاست؛ اما حال و هوای واقعی دربی تو اینفیلده، با کلاه‌ها و چیزایی که نمادشن.» عکسای قدیمی کلاه‌ها واسش نماد زمانی‌ان که سنت دربی مهم بود، قبل اینکه مسئولان بخوان کم‌رنگش کنن. (گفته می‌شه سی‌ان‌ان گزارش‌هایی از محدودیت طرفدارای دربی دریافت کرده اما مسئولان این رو رد می‌کنن. عکس قشنگی از کلاه دربی داری؟ واسه iReport بفرست! کریستینا زدانویچ از سی‌ان‌ان تو آماده‌سازی این گزارش همکاری داشته.)

article_content: Kenya's government will shut down all privately owned orphanages and children's homes within eight years, potentially leaving thousands of children homeless, according to reports. Minister of Social Protection Florence Bore insists closures aim to stop rampant child trafficking but hasn't detailed how displaced children will be cared for. Government claims that children will supposedly be placed in family and community care, but many observers fear several could disappear amid the resulting chaos. The 2017 UN children's agency report suggested at least 40,000 children already live in 811 institutions, while many more in unregistered homes remain unaccounted for. Posting on X (formerly Twitter), Ms Bore declared reforms are underway and boasted, 'In the next eight years private homes will not exist. We need to prepare in order to absorb those children.' Still, with so many at risk, critics say such promises are unrealistic. Although some children will continue in state-run facilities managed by the Child Welfare Society of Kenya, these services are allegedly overburdened and underfunded. Experts warn that ending private orphanages could force children onto the streets or into the hands of traffickers. Kenya's attempt to phase out private orphanages emerged from the controversial 2022 Children's Act, which detractors argue was rushed without enough input and fails to give real options. Reports suggesting organized crime groups have infiltrated orphanages to traffic children have fueled fears. In 2017, an NGO claimed some orphanages in Kenya deceived families into giving up children, then used them to generate donations for personal gain. Now, many citizens believe mass closures could spark a serious crisis.

article_content: On October 7th, while Noam Tibon was swimming in the Mediterranean, he received an alarming message: Hamas militants had infiltrated his son's southern Israeli community. The retired army major general immediately told his son to take shelter, armed himself, and sped south from Tel Aviv, making unsuccessful attempts to reach military commanders. When Tibon met Israeli soldiers, they declined to advance without explicit orders—a sign, he felt, of serious disorganization. Tibon holds Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu directly responsible, asserting that Netanyahu should resign due to this security failure. The Hamas assault left Israel reeling: about 1,200 people were killed and more than 240 kidnapped, according to Israeli authorities. Israel's subsequent offensives in Gaza, governed by Hamas, have resulted in over 11,000 reported Palestinian deaths. Public anger has mounted. Recent polls show a significant majority—76%—of Israelis wanting Netanyahu to step down. Some pro-Netanyahu media outlets have even called for his resignation after the war. Netanyahu, who has led Israel for much of the past 16 years, is criticized for shifting from his security-first image. He has been accused of empowering far-right religious groups, expanding settlements in the West Bank (alienating the moderate Palestinian Authority), and indirectly strengthening Hamas to sow division among Palestinian leaders. His government's pursuit of controversial judicial reforms, which weakened court powers, drew widespread protests and fractured Israeli society. Since the October 7 attack, criticism of Netanyahu has grown more unified. Notable officials, including members of his Likud party from affected regions, have quit and called for government accountability. Hostage families have also joined demonstrations, though they are not unanimous in their demands. Defense leaders have accepted blame for security shortcomings. Netanyahu has acknowledged mistakes but also blamed defense and intelligence services for poor information, promising an inquiry after the conflict. He has refused to resign, saying the war effort must remain the focus. Protests against Netanyahu persist, including renewed use of anti-government slogans. His supporters argue that the October 7 attack was beyond the government’s control and see critics as politically motivated. Analysts note that changes in leadership during wartime are rare in Israel. Even some critics believe it’s unlikely to happen while conflict continues. For Tibon, the experience was deeply personal—he directly intervened to save his family and insists that new leadership is needed if others are to be spared similar ordeals in the future.
translated_content: در هفتم اکتبر، زمانی‌که نوآم تیبون در دریای مدیترانه شنا می‌کرد، یک پیام هشداردهنده دریافت کرد: نیروهای حماس وارد اجتماع پسرش در جنوب اسرائیل شده‌اند. این سردار بازنشسته ارتش فوراً به پسرش گفت در پناهگاه بماند، خودش مسلح شد و از تل‌آویو به سمت جنوب حرکت کرد ولی نتوانست با فرماندهان نظامی تماس برقرار کند. وقتی تیبون به سربازان اسرائیلی رسید، آن‌ها بدون دریافت دستور مشخصی حاضر نشدند جلو بروند—به‌گفته او این نشانه بی‌نظمی شدید بود. تیبون، بنیامین نتانیاهو نخست‌وزیر را مقصر اصلی این ناکامی امنیتی می‌داند و معتقد است باید فوراً استعفا دهد. حملات حماس اسرائیل را متحیر کرد: بنابر اعلام مقامات اسرائیلی حدود ۱۲۰۰ نفر کشته و بیش از ۲۴۰ نفر گروگان گرفته شدند. حملات بعدی اسرائیل به غزه که توسط حماس اداره می‌شود، باعث مرگ بیش از ۱۱۰۰۰ فلسطینی شده‌است. نارضایتی مردم شدت یافته. طبق نظرسنجی‌های اخیر، اکثریت چشمگیر—۷۶ درصد—اسرائیلی‌ها خواهان استعفای نتانیاهو هستند. حتی برخی رسانه‌های طرفدار او نیز پس از پایان جنگ از وی خواسته‌اند کناره‌گیری کند. نتانیاهو که در بیشتر ۱۶ سال اخیر نخست‌وزیر بوده، بابت فاصله گرفتن از رویکرد امنیت‌محور همیشگی‌اش مورد انتقاد قرار گرفته‌است. او متهم است با تقویت احزاب مذهبی افراطی، گسترش شهرک‌سازی‌ها در کرانه باختری (که باعث دور افتادن حکومت خودگردان فلسطین شده) و حتی به صورت غیرمستقیم با تقویت حماس برای ایجاد تفرقه در رهبری فلسطین، اوضاع را ناامن‌تر کرده‌است. تلاش دولت او برای اصلاح دادگستری، که قدرت دادگاه‌ها را کاهش داد، به اعتراضات فراوان و شکاف گسترده در اسرائیل انجامید. پس از واقعه ۷ اکتبر، انتقادها علیه نتانیاهو متحدتر شده‌است؛ برخی مقامات از جمله اعضای لیکود از مناطق حمله‌دیده استعفا داده‌اند و خواهان پاسخگویی دولت شده‌اند. خانواده اسرا و گروگان‌ها نیز به این اعتراضات پیوسته‌اند، هرچند یکپارچگی نظر ندارند. مقامات ارتش اسرائیل مسئولیت مشکلات امنیتی را پذیرفته‌اند. نتانیاهو ضمن پذیرش برخی اشتباهات، سرویس‌های امنیتی را بخاطر اطلاعات غلط مقصر دانسته و وعده بررسی پس از پایان جنگ را داده است. او استعفا را رد کرده و می‌گوید مبارزه با حماس اولویت دارد. اعتراضات مردمی علیه نتانیاهو همچنان ادامه دارد و شعارهای منتقدان دوباره شنیده می‌شود. طرفداران نتانیاهو اما می‌گویند حمله ۷ اکتبر خارج از کنترل دولت بوده و منتقدان را سیاسی می‌نامند. کارشناسان اشاره می‌کنند که تغییر رهبری در بحبوحه جنگ در اسرائیل بسیار کم‌سابقه است و حتی برخی منتقدان هم وقوع آن در زمان درگیری را غیرمحتمل می‌دانند. به گفته تیبون، این رویداد برای او کاملاً شخصی بود—خودش مستقیماً برای نجات خانواده‌اش اقدام کرد و معتقد است تنها با تغییر رهبری می‌توان از وقوع چنین فجایعی برای دیگر خانواده‌ها جلوگیری کرد.
